deva:
युगादिदेवाय युगादियोगिने युगादिराजाय युगादिशिल्पिने।
अपारसंसारपयोधिसेतवे नमो नमस्ते जिन! मुक्तिहेतवे॥
iast:
yugādidevāya yugādiyogine yugādirājāya yugādiśilpine.
apārasaṃsārapayodhisetave namo namaste jina! muktihetave..
hk:
yugAdidevAya yugAdiyogine yugAdirAjAya yugAdizilpine.
apArasaMsArapayodhisetave namo namaste jina! muktihetave..

deva:
अलोकमाक्रामति यः सलीलया विशीर्णसीमार्गलमेकझम्पया।
स एव ते वृत्तविशेषवर्णनाविधानसंरम्भपरः परं नरः॥
iast:
alokamākrāmati yaḥ salīlayā viśīrṇasīmārgalamekajhampayā.
sa eva te vṛttaviśeṣavarṇanāvidhānasaṃrambhaparaḥ paraṃ naraḥ..
hk:
alokamAkrAmati yaH salIlayA vizIrNasImArgalamekajhampayA.
sa eva te vRttavizeSavarNanAvidhAnasaMrambhaparaH paraM naraH..

deva:
बलिं व्रजामः कतिशः स्वयं वयं सुमेधसस्तस्य महेश! वेधसः।
भवद्गुणग्रामसमृद्धिशंसिनीं चकार वाणीं विदुषां मुखेषु यः॥
iast:
baliṃ vrajāmaḥ katiśaḥ svayaṃ vayaṃ sumedhasastasya maheśa! vedhasaḥ.
bhavadguṇagrāmasamṛddhiśaṃsinīṃ cakāra vāṇīṃ viduṣāṃ mukheṣu yaḥ..
hk:
baliM vrajAmaH katizaH svayaM vayaM sumedhasastasya maheza! vedhasaH.
bhavadguNagrAmasamRddhizaMsinIM cakAra vANIM viduSAM mukheSu yaH..

deva:
अजानतां भेदमुषर्बुधांभसोः स्वयं स येषामभवद् भवान् गुरुः।
अशेषसम्पत्तिविलाससम्पदां त्रिसन्ध्यमेषामहमानतस्त्रिधा॥
iast:
ajānatāṃ bhedamuṣarbudhāṃbhasoḥ svayaṃ sa yeṣāmabhavad bhavān guruḥ.
aśeṣasampattivilāsasampadāṃ trisandhyameṣāmahamānatastridhā..
hk:
ajAnatAM bhedamuSarbudhAMbhasoH svayaM sa yeSAmabhavad bhavAn guruH.
azeSasampattivilAsasampadAM trisandhyameSAmahamAnatastridhA..

deva:
इमामशेषां प्रविभज्य काश्यपीं यथायथं पुत्रशताय कल्पयन्।
विधातुकामो विषयोपसंहृतिं व्यधत्त भूम्ना विषयान् कथं भवान्॥
iast:
imāmaśeṣāṃ pravibhajya kāśyapīṃ yathāyathaṃ putraśatāya kalpayan.
vidhātukāmo viṣayopasaṃhṛtiṃ vyadhatta bhūmnā viṣayān kathaṃ bhavān..
hk:
imAmazeSAM pravibhajya kAzyapIM yathAyathaM putrazatAya kalpayan.
vidhAtukAmo viSayopasaMhRtiM vyadhatta bhUmnA viSayAn kathaM bhavAn..

deva:
बभूव नैकोऽपि समुद्रमाश्रयन्नमुं प्रचेताश्च्युतपाशवैशसः।
भवन्तमाराध्य समुद्रशेखरं पुनर्विपाशाः कति न प्रचेतसः॥
iast:
babhūva naiko'pi samudramāśrayannamuṃ pracetāścyutapāśavaiśasaḥ.
bhavantamārādhya samudraśekharaṃ punarvipāśāḥ kati na pracetasaḥ..
hk:
babhUva naiko'pi samudramAzrayannamuM pracetAzcyutapAzavaizasaH.
bhavantamArAdhya samudrazekharaM punarvipAzAH kati na pracetasaH..

deva:
नमोऽस्तु तस्मै भुवनोपकारिणे मनः प्रयत्नाय यथाप्रवृत्तये।
सदाऽप्यनासादिततत्त्वविप्रुषो यतस्तवोक्तं स्पृहयन्ति जन्तवः॥
iast:
namo'stu tasmai bhuvanopakāriṇe manaḥ prayatnāya yathāpravṛttaye.
sadā'pyanāsāditatattvavipruṣo yatastavoktaṃ spṛhayanti jantavaḥ..
hk:
namo'stu tasmai bhuvanopakAriNe manaH prayatnAya yathApravRttaye.
sadA'pyanAsAditatattvavipruSo yatastavoktaM spRhayanti jantavaH..

deva:
तपोभिरुग्रैः करणोपरोधनैरकृत्रिमैरादधतस्तव स्थितिम्।
विपश्चितः के न भवन्ति हेतुना सचेतसोऽपि प्रविलीनचेतसः॥
iast:
tapobhirugraiḥ karaṇoparodhanairakṛtrimairādadhatastava sthitim.
vipaścitaḥ ke na bhavanti hetunā sacetaso'pi pravilīnacetasaḥ..
hk:
tapobhirugraiH karaNoparodhanairakRtrimairAdadhatastava sthitim.
vipazcitaH ke na bhavanti hetunA sacetaso'pi pravilInacetasaH..

deva:
तमःप्रणष्टामलदृष्टिवर्त्मनि प्रबद्धमिधे(?) प्रभवद्भि(?) कर्मणि।
रवेरिवोन्मीलितभाववैभवस्तवावतारं जिन! भारतेऽभवत्॥
iast:
tamaḥpraṇaṣṭāmaladṛṣṭivartmani prabaddhamidhe(?) prabhavadbhi(?) karmaṇi.
raverivonmīlitabhāvavaibhavastavāvatāraṃ jina! bhārate'bhavat..
hk:
tamaHpraNaSTAmaladRSTivartmani prabaddhamidhe(?) prabhavadbhi(?) karmaNi.
raverivonmIlitabhAvavaibhavastavAvatAraM jina! bhArate'bhavat..

deva:
तवांघ्रिसेवारसिकैः कुटुम्बितामिह प्रपन्नैरवनौ सुरासुरैः।
कृताचिरं यामिकमात्रदेहिनो (त) रसातलस्वर्गनिवासिनो ग्रहाः॥
iast:
tavāṃghrisevārasikaiḥ kuṭumbitāmiha prapannairavanau surāsuraiḥ.
kṛtāciraṃ yāmikamātradehino (ta) rasātalasvarganivāsino grahāḥ..
hk:
tavAMghrisevArasikaiH kuTumbitAmiha prapannairavanau surAsuraiH.
kRtAciraM yAmikamAtradehino (ta) rasAtalasvarganivAsino grahAH..

deva:
अमुं प्रमथ्नन्ति न ये जडाविलं तवाध्वमन्थेन भवोदधिं बुधाः।
भवन्ति सर्वेन्द्रियशान्तवेधसो न ते नवीनाऽमृतसम्पदां पदम्॥
iast:
amuṃ pramathnanti na ye jaḍāvilaṃ tavādhvamanthena bhavodadhiṃ budhāḥ.
bhavanti sarvendriyaśāntavedhaso na te navīnā'mṛtasampadāṃ padam..
hk:
amuM pramathnanti na ye jaDAvilaM tavAdhvamanthena bhavodadhiM budhAH.
bhavanti sarvendriyazAntavedhaso na te navInA'mRtasampadAM padam..

deva:
निवासमर्हन्ति न ये महोदधे (?) मलीमसा मुक्तिपुरे वपुः स्पृशः।
कृता भवग्रामतलेषु ते त्वया विपन्नृपाणां करदाः कुटुम्बिनः॥
iast:
nivāsamarhanti na ye mahodadhe (?) malīmasā muktipure vapuḥ spṛśaḥ.
kṛtā bhavagrāmataleṣu te tvayā vipannṛpāṇāṃ karadāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ..
hk:
nivAsamarhanti na ye mahodadhe (?) malImasA muktipure vapuH spRzaH.
kRtA bhavagrAmataleSu te tvayA vipannRpANAM karadAH kuTumbinaH..

deva:
महांहसां दुर्नयशूरचेतसां विमोहमूर्द्धालुदृशां च मादृशाम्।
शरण्य! को नाम सकर्णमानसो ध्रुवं त्वदन्यः शरणं भवे भवेत्॥
iast:
mahāṃhasāṃ durnayaśūracetasāṃ vimohamūrddhāludṛśāṃ ca mādṛśām.
śaraṇya! ko nāma sakarṇamānaso dhruvaṃ tvadanyaḥ śaraṇaṃ bhave bhavet..
hk:
mahAMhasAM durnayazUracetasAM vimohamUrddhAludRzAM ca mAdRzAm.
zaraNya! ko nAma sakarNamAnaso dhruvaM tvadanyaH zaraNaM bhave bhavet..

deva:
बृहन्न किञ्चिद् गगनाङ्गणात् परं न चाऽपरं मुक्तिपदात् प्रियङ्करम्।
न बीजमन्यद् व्यसनस्य कामतः परो न कश्चिद् भवतो यथार्थवाक्॥
iast:
bṛhanna kiñcid gaganāṅgaṇāt paraṃ na cā'paraṃ muktipadāt priyaṅkaram.
na bījamanyad vyasanasya kāmataḥ paro na kaścid bhavato yathārthavāk..
hk:
bRhanna kiJcid gaganAGgaNAt paraM na cA'paraM muktipadAt priyaGkaram.
na bIjamanyad vyasanasya kAmataH paro na kazcid bhavato yathArthavAk..

deva:
अहंयवो ये किल रोषतोषजैः परे प्रबन्धै रिपुमित्रवर्द्धिभिः।
उपासितैस्तैर्मनसाऽपि मादृशाश्चिरं त्रपन्ते तव किङ्करा अपि॥
iast:
ahaṃyavo ye kila roṣatoṣajaiḥ pare prabandhai ripumitravarddhibhiḥ.
upāsitaistairmanasā'pi mādṛśāściraṃ trapante tava kiṅkarā api..
hk:
ahaMyavo ye kila roSatoSajaiH pare prabandhai ripumitravarddhibhiH.
upAsitaistairmanasA'pi mAdRzAzciraM trapante tava kiGkarA api..

deva:
वसुन्धरामश्नुवतां नृपार्चिता भवन्तु शास्त्रैरपि सन्तु विश्रुताः।
सुखोन्मुखे चेत् पथि सोत्सवाः परे तदा भुजिष्यैस्तव मादृशैर्जितम्॥
iast:
vasundharāmaśnuvatāṃ nṛpārcitā bhavantu śāstrairapi santu viśrutāḥ.
sukhonmukhe cet pathi sotsavāḥ pare tadā bhujiṣyaistava mādṛśairjitam..
hk:
vasundharAmaznuvatAM nRpArcitA bhavantu zAstrairapi santu vizrutAH.
sukhonmukhe cet pathi sotsavAH pare tadA bhujiSyaistava mAdRzairjitam..

deva:
अखण्डताखण्डलवन्दितश्रिया त्वया त्यजन्तः सह साम्यविप्लवम्।
सुधामयीं तामपि मुक्तिभूमिकां मनीषिणो न स्पृहयन्ति चेतसि॥
iast:
akhaṇḍatākhaṇḍalavanditaśriyā tvayā tyajantaḥ saha sāmyaviplavam.
sudhāmayīṃ tāmapi muktibhūmikāṃ manīṣiṇo na spṛhayanti cetasi..
hk:
akhaNDatAkhaNDalavanditazriyA tvayA tyajantaH saha sAmyaviplavam.
sudhAmayIM tAmapi muktibhUmikAM manISiNo na spRhayanti cetasi..

deva:
त्रिलोकरक्षाभिरिहाभिमन्त्रितः प्रियङ्कराभिस्तव सूक्तिपङ्क्तिभिः।
दृढानुबन्धैरपुनर्ग्रहं ग्रहैश्चिरं गृहीतोऽपि न कोऽपि मुच्यते॥
iast:
trilokarakṣābhirihābhimantritaḥ priyaṅkarābhistava sūktipaṅktibhiḥ.
dṛḍhānubandhairapunargrahaṃ grahaiściraṃ gṛhīto'pi na ko'pi mucyate..
hk:
trilokarakSAbhirihAbhimantritaH priyaGkarAbhistava sUktipaGktibhiH.
dRDhAnubandhairapunargrahaM grahaizciraM gRhIto'pi na ko'pi mucyate..

deva:
व्रतं विहाय स्पृहयन्ति ये श्रियं व्रजन्ति ते पूज्यतमां परे दशाम्।
त्वया पुनर्देव! विमुञ्चतां व्रतं स्थितिः प्रकॢप्ता मलिनानुरूपिणी॥
iast:
vrataṃ vihāya spṛhayanti ye śriyaṃ vrajanti te pūjyatamāṃ pare daśām.
tvayā punardeva! vimuñcatāṃ vrataṃ sthitiḥ prakḷptā malinānurūpiṇī..
hk:
vrataM vihAya spRhayanti ye zriyaM vrajanti te pUjyatamAM pare dazAm.
tvayA punardeva! vimuJcatAM vrataM sthitiH praklRptA malinAnurUpiNI..

deva:
तदेव नास्त्यस्ति तदेव चेत्ययं चलाचलस्ते वचनस्य डम्बरः।
शिवाय कस्याऽप्यशिवाय कस्यचिन्मुदेऽथ कस्याप्यमुदेऽथ कस्यचित्॥
iast:
tadeva nāstyasti tadeva cetyayaṃ calācalaste vacanasya ḍambaraḥ.
śivāya kasyā'pyaśivāya kasyacinmude'tha kasyāpyamude'tha kasyacit..
hk:
tadeva nAstyasti tadeva cetyayaM calAcalaste vacanasya DambaraH.
zivAya kasyA'pyazivAya kasyacinmude'tha kasyApyamude'tha kasyacit..

deva:
अमुत्र यत् किञ्चिदचिन्त्यवैभवं सनातनं शर्म न तत्र साक्षिणः।
इहापि गच्छंस्तव देव! वर्त्मना भवत्यवाच्यस्य न भाजनं जनः॥
iast:
amutra yat kiñcidacintyavaibhavaṃ sanātanaṃ śarma na tatra sākṣiṇaḥ.
ihāpi gacchaṃstava deva! vartmanā bhavatyavācyasya na bhājanaṃ janaḥ..
hk:
amutra yat kiJcidacintyavaibhavaM sanAtanaM zarma na tatra sAkSiNaH.
ihApi gacchaMstava deva! vartmanA bhavatyavAcyasya na bhAjanaM janaH..

deva:
गुणैकरूपा गमभङ्गशालिनी चकास्ति येयं तव वाक्यवागुरा।
स एव दूरं विनियन्त्र्यते न या य एव बन्धैरचिराय मुच्यते॥
iast:
guṇaikarūpā gamabhaṅgaśālinī cakāsti yeyaṃ tava vākyavāgurā.
sa eva dūraṃ viniyantryate na yā ya eva bandhairacirāya mucyate..
hk:
guNaikarUpA gamabhaGgazAlinI cakAsti yeyaM tava vAkyavAgurA.
sa eva dUraM viniyantryate na yA ya eva bandhairacirAya mucyate..

deva:
प्रसीद सीदन्तममुं जगज्जनं नियोजय क्वाऽपि महार्थकर्मणि।
क्षमाभृति त्वय्यपि शासति प्रजामजातदैन्याः कथमीश! नाङ्गिनः॥
iast:
prasīda sīdantamamuṃ jagajjanaṃ niyojaya kvā'pi mahārthakarmaṇi.
kṣamābhṛti tvayyapi śāsati prajāmajātadainyāḥ kathamīśa! nāṅginaḥ..
hk:
prasIda sIdantamamuM jagajjanaM niyojaya kvA'pi mahArthakarmaNi.
kSamAbhRti tvayyapi zAsati prajAmajAtadainyAH kathamIza! nAGginaH..

deva:
ऋतुक्रियाभिर्विषयोपदेशनां निशम्य वाचो हृदयमा जनः।
विरोधिनीर्वैषयिकस्य शर्मणः क एव ते सूक्ष्मगिरोऽनुरुध्यते॥
iast:
ṛtukriyābhirviṣayopadeśanāṃ niśamya vāco hṛdayamā janaḥ.
virodhinīrvaiṣayikasya śarmaṇaḥ ka eva te sūkṣmagiro'nurudhyate..
hk:
RtukriyAbhirviSayopadezanAM nizamya vAco hRdayamA janaH.
virodhinIrvaiSayikasya zarmaNaH ka eva te sUkSmagiro'nurudhyate..

deva:
विशृङ्खलैर्योऽमृतपोऽपि लज्जते प्रियाप्रणामप्रमुखैर्विकर्मभिः।
परां परेतैरपि यान्ति पूज्यतामहो विमोहान्धलमानसं जगत्॥
iast:
viśṛṅkhalairyo'mṛtapo'pi lajjate priyāpraṇāmapramukhairvikarmabhiḥ.
parāṃ paretairapi yānti pūjyatāmaho vimohāndhalamānasaṃ jagat..
hk:
vizRGkhalairyo'mRtapo'pi lajjate priyApraNAmapramukhairvikarmabhiH.
parAM paretairapi yAnti pUjyatAmaho vimohAndhalamAnasaM jagat..

deva:
प्रसादमासाथ कुतीर्थिनां जनः स लाघवोऽपि ध्रुवमेत्य गौरवम्।
तव प्रा(प्र?)सादा(न्)न पुनर्मुहुर्मुहुः स गौरवोऽप्यञ्चति लाघवं परम्॥
iast:
prasādamāsātha kutīrthināṃ janaḥ sa lāghavo'pi dhruvametya gauravam.
tava prā(pra?)sādā(n)na punarmuhurmuhuḥ sa gauravo'pyañcati lāghavaṃ param..
hk:
prasAdamAsAtha kutIrthinAM janaH sa lAghavo'pi dhruvametya gauravam.
tava prA(pra?)sAdA(n)na punarmuhurmuhuH sa gauravo'pyaJcati lAghavaM param..

deva:
अकल्पवृक्षा विबुधप्ररोहिणी विशीर्णदोषा गुरुराजराजिनी।
समुत्थितज्योतिरकृष्णवर्त्मिका त्वयि प्रभो! सारतभूरभूदियम्॥
iast:
akalpavṛkṣā vibudhaprarohiṇī viśīrṇadoṣā gururājarājinī.
samutthitajyotirakṛṣṇavartmikā tvayi prabho! sāratabhūrabhūdiyam..
hk:
akalpavRkSA vibudhaprarohiNI vizIrNadoSA gururAjarAjinI.
samutthitajyotirakRSNavartmikA tvayi prabho! sAratabhUrabhUdiyam..

deva:
शुभाशुभं बाह्यमथान्तरं भवत्प्रणीतसंवादि विलोकयन्नपि।
प्रशान्तिवन्ध्यैर्ग्रहिलाभिरुक्तिभिः प्रतार्यते पश्य परैः कथं जनः॥
iast:
śubhāśubhaṃ bāhyamathāntaraṃ bhavatpraṇītasaṃvādi vilokayannapi.
praśāntivandhyairgrahilābhiruktibhiḥ pratāryate paśya paraiḥ kathaṃ janaḥ..
hk:
zubhAzubhaM bAhyamathAntaraM bhavatpraNItasaMvAdi vilokayannapi.
prazAntivandhyairgrahilAbhiruktibhiH pratAryate pazya paraiH kathaM janaH..

deva:
सतां न तत् कौतुकमस्तु विप्लुते यदेष भूयांस्तव गौरवोदयः।
कृपाद्विषः कामजुषः परां परे यदञ्चितिं यान्ति तदेव कौतुकम्॥
iast:
satāṃ na tat kautukamastu viplute yadeṣa bhūyāṃstava gauravodayaḥ.
kṛpādviṣaḥ kāmajuṣaḥ parāṃ pare yadañcitiṃ yānti tadeva kautukam..
hk:
satAM na tat kautukamastu viplute yadeSa bhUyAMstava gauravodayaH.
kRpAdviSaH kAmajuSaH parAM pare yadaJcitiM yAnti tadeva kautukam..

deva:
पटूनि चाटूनि कियन्ति कुर्महे महेश! युष्माकमपारसम्पदाम्।
विना न यः शर्म सतां सदोदयं वचोभिरेभिः किल किं न पूर्यते॥
iast:
paṭūni cāṭūni kiyanti kurmahe maheśa! yuṣmākamapārasampadām.
vinā na yaḥ śarma satāṃ sadodayaṃ vacobhirebhiḥ kila kiṃ na pūryate..
hk:
paTUni cATUni kiyanti kurmahe maheza! yuSmAkamapArasampadAm.
vinA na yaH zarma satAM sadodayaM vacobhirebhiH kila kiM na pUryate..

deva:
विघटय कलुषाणि भुर्भुवःस्वर्धटय घटां शिवसम्पदामपाराम्।
उपनय गुरुकर्म्ममर्मभेदं नय भवभीतिमसम्भवामवस्थाम्॥
iast:
vighaṭaya kaluṣāṇi bhurbhuvaḥsvardhaṭaya ghaṭāṃ śivasampadāmapārām.
upanaya gurukarmmamarmabhedaṃ naya bhavabhītimasambhavāmavasthām..
hk:
vighaTaya kaluSANi bhurbhuvaHsvardhaTaya ghaTAM zivasampadAmapArAm.
upanaya gurukarmmamarmabhedaM naya bhavabhItimasambhavAmavasthAm..

deva:
माहात्म्यं तव परिमातुमीहते यः सख्यातुं जगदणुसञ्चयं स लोलः।
साफल्यं तदपि सुमेधसः स्ववाचामाधातुं विदधति ते गुणप्रशस्तिम्॥
iast:
māhātmyaṃ tava parimātumīhate yaḥ sakhyātuṃ jagadaṇusañcayaṃ sa lolaḥ.
sāphalyaṃ tadapi sumedhasaḥ svavācāmādhātuṃ vidadhati te guṇapraśastim..
hk:
mAhAtmyaM tava parimAtumIhate yaH sakhyAtuM jagadaNusaJcayaM sa lolaH.
sAphalyaM tadapi sumedhasaH svavAcAmAdhAtuM vidadhati te guNaprazastim..

deva:
तां पुण्यपापजयिनीं कनकाभिरामचन्द्रांशुपुञ्जविशदामधिगम्य भूमिम्।
आत्यन्तिकीमनुभवामि यथा मुदं मे श्रीनाभिनन्दन! तथा प्रथय प्रसादम्॥
iast:
tāṃ puṇyapāpajayinīṃ kanakābhirāmacandrāṃśupuñjaviśadāmadhigamya bhūmim.
ātyantikīmanubhavāmi yathā mudaṃ me śrīnābhinandana! tathā prathaya prasādam..
hk:
tAM puNyapApajayinIM kanakAbhirAmacandrAMzupuJjavizadAmadhigamya bhUmim.
AtyantikImanubhavAmi yathA mudaM me zrInAbhinandana! tathA prathaya prasAdam..

deva:
प्रणम्य स्फुरत्स्वर्णशैलप्रभावं प्रभापूरदूरीकृतध्वान्तभावम्।
युगादीश्वरं लब्धविश्वस्वरूपं स्तवे किञ्चिनाऽहं सुसिद्धस्वरूपम्॥
iast:
praṇamya sphuratsvarṇaśailaprabhāvaṃ prabhāpūradūrīkṛtadhvāntabhāvam.
yugādīśvaraṃ labdhaviśvasvarūpaṃ stave kiñcinā'haṃ susiddhasvarūpam..
hk:
praNamya sphuratsvarNazailaprabhAvaM prabhApUradUrIkRtadhvAntabhAvam.
yugAdIzvaraM labdhavizvasvarUpaM stave kiJcinA'haM susiddhasvarUpam..

deva:
न पाणिर्न पादौ न मौलिर्न वक्त्रं न वक्षो न श्रोत्रे न कर्णौ न कण्ठः।
न चायुर्न पायुर्न मौलिर्न कायः कषायो भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na pāṇirna pādau na maulirna vaktraṃ na vakṣo na śrotre na karṇau na kaṇṭhaḥ.
na cāyurna pāyurna maulirna kāyaḥ kaṣāyo bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na pANirna pAdau na maulirna vaktraM na vakSo na zrotre na karNau na kaNThaH.
na cAyurna pAyurna maulirna kAyaH kaSAyo bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न खेदो न वेदो न सेकः प्रवेगो न कुन्दं न तुन्दं न बाहुर्न चोरूः।
न जङ्घे न पार्श्वे न चांऽसौ न मांसं भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na khedo na vedo na sekaḥ pravego na kundaṃ na tundaṃ na bāhurna corūḥ.
na jaṅghe na pārśve na cāṃ'sau na māṃsaṃ bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na khedo na vedo na sekaH pravego na kundaM na tundaM na bAhurna corUH.
na jaGghe na pArzve na cAM'sau na mAMsaM bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न रोषो न दोषो न शोषो न पोषो न रागो न यागो न तागो न चामः।
न यानं न पानं न दानं न लाभो भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na roṣo na doṣo na śoṣo na poṣo na rāgo na yāgo na tāgo na cāmaḥ.
na yānaṃ na pānaṃ na dānaṃ na lābho bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na roSo na doSo na zoSo na poSo na rAgo na yAgo na tAgo na cAmaH.
na yAnaM na pAnaM na dAnaM na lAbho bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न यन्त्रं न तन्त्रं न मन्त्रं कलत्रं न मित्रं न चित्रं न वस्त्रं न शस्त्रम्।
न पात्रं न नात्रं न यात्रा न मात्रा भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na yantraṃ na tantraṃ na mantraṃ kalatraṃ na mitraṃ na citraṃ na vastraṃ na śastram.
na pātraṃ na nātraṃ na yātrā na mātrā bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na yantraM na tantraM na mantraM kalatraM na mitraM na citraM na vastraM na zastram.
na pAtraM na nAtraM na yAtrA na mAtrA bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न तापो न शापो न जापो न लापो न पापं न पुण्यं न गुण्यं हिरण्यम्।
न कालः करालो न भालं विशालं भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na tāpo na śāpo na jāpo na lāpo na pāpaṃ na puṇyaṃ na guṇyaṃ hiraṇyam.
na kālaḥ karālo na bhālaṃ viśālaṃ bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na tApo na zApo na jApo na lApo na pApaM na puNyaM na guNyaM hiraNyam.
na kAlaH karAlo na bhAlaM vizAlaM bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
अनङ्गो न रङ्गो न भङ्गो न चङ्गो न चङ्गस्तुरङ्गः कुरङ्गो विहङ्गः।
न शाणिर्न वाणि न वेणिर्न वेणो भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
anaṅgo na raṅgo na bhaṅgo na caṅgo na caṅgasturaṅgaḥ kuraṅgo vihaṅgaḥ.
na śāṇirna vāṇi na veṇirna veṇo bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
anaGgo na raGgo na bhaGgo na caGgo na caGgasturaGgaH kuraGgo vihaGgaH.
na zANirna vANi na veNirna veNo bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न ऋद्धिर्न वृद्धिर्न हानिर्न खानी न केशो न वेशो न नाशो न पाशः।
न नाभिः स नाभिर्न सारङ्गनाभिर्भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na ṛddhirna vṛddhirna hānirna khānī na keśo na veśo na nāśo na pāśaḥ.
na nābhiḥ sa nābhirna sāraṅganābhirbhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na Rddhirna vRddhirna hAnirna khAnI na kezo na vezo na nAzo na pAzaH.
na nAbhiH sa nAbhirna sAraGganAbhirbhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न हास्यं न लास्यं न भास्यं न दास्यं न भीतिर्न रीतिर्न गीतिर्न हीतिः।
न भोगो न रागो (रोगो?) वियोगः प्रयोगो भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na hāsyaṃ na lāsyaṃ na bhāsyaṃ na dāsyaṃ na bhītirna rītirna gītirna hītiḥ.
na bhogo na rāgo (rogo?) viyogaḥ prayogo bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na hAsyaM na lAsyaM na bhAsyaM na dAsyaM na bhItirna rItirna gItirna hItiH.
na bhogo na rAgo (rogo?) viyogaH prayogo bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न लोभः ससम्भो न दम्भो न चाऽम्भो न मोहो न रोहो न द्रोहो न वोहः।
अपायाः सहाया न माया न काया भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na lobhaḥ sasambho na dambho na cā'mbho na moho na roho na droho na vohaḥ.
apāyāḥ sahāyā na māyā na kāyā bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na lobhaH sasambho na dambho na cA'mbho na moho na roho na droho na vohaH.
apAyAH sahAyA na mAyA na kAyA bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न माला न शाला न दोला न लोलो न पीतो न भ्राता न माता पिता न।
न शय्यातिचर्या न पद्मा न पद्मं भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na mālā na śālā na dolā na lolo na pīto na bhrātā na mātā pitā na.
na śayyāticaryā na padmā na padmaṃ bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na mAlA na zAlA na dolA na lolo na pIto na bhrAtA na mAtA pitA na.
na zayyAticaryA na padmA na padmaM bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न सैन्यं न दैन्यं न हारः प्रहारो न सूत्रं न मूत्रं न जग्धिः पुरीषम्।
न रक्तं न भक्तं न धर्मो न नक्तं भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na sainyaṃ na dainyaṃ na hāraḥ prahāro na sūtraṃ na mūtraṃ na jagdhiḥ purīṣam.
na raktaṃ na bhaktaṃ na dharmo na naktaṃ bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na sainyaM na dainyaM na hAraH prahAro na sUtraM na mUtraM na jagdhiH purISam.
na raktaM na bhaktaM na dharmo na naktaM bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न नागो न हि चन्दनाद्याङ्गरागो न कामो न कस्मिंश्चनाऽपि प्रणामः।
न मादो न वादो न सादः प्रसादः भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na nāgo na hi candanādyāṅgarāgo na kāmo na kasmiṃścanā'pi praṇāmaḥ.
na mādo na vādo na sādaḥ prasādaḥ bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na nAgo na hi candanAdyAGgarAgo na kAmo na kasmiMzcanA'pi praNAmaH.
na mAdo na vAdo na sAdaH prasAdaH bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न वेलापवेला न खेला न हेला न फेला न वेला विपत्तिर्न पत्तिः।
न दन्ता न यन्ता रथा नो न दन्तो भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na velāpavelā na khelā na helā na phelā na velā vipattirna pattiḥ.
na dantā na yantā rathā no na danto bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na velApavelA na khelA na helA na phelA na velA vipattirna pattiH.
na dantA na yantA rathA no na danto bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न कूपो न भूपो न यूपो न रूपो न सर्पो न दर्पः प्रवीणा न वीणा।
न शूलं न तूलं न मूलं न पूलं भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na kūpo na bhūpo na yūpo na rūpo na sarpo na darpaḥ pravīṇā na vīṇā.
na śūlaṃ na tūlaṃ na mūlaṃ na pūlaṃ bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na kUpo na bhUpo na yUpo na rUpo na sarpo na darpaH pravINA na vINA.
na zUlaM na tUlaM na mUlaM na pUlaM bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न निद्रा न मुद्रा न पुत्रो न पौत्रो न बन्धुर्न शत्रुर्न सारिर्न मारी।
कफातिर्न वातो न पित्तं न वित्तं भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na nidrā na mudrā na putro na pautro na bandhurna śatrurna sārirna mārī.
kaphātirna vāto na pittaṃ na vittaṃ bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na nidrA na mudrA na putro na pautro na bandhurna zatrurna sArirna mArI.
kaphAtirna vAto na pittaM na vittaM bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न कण्ठी न पीठी न यष्टिर्न मुष्टिर्न वंशो न दंशो न गण्डः प्रगण्डः।
न मेषो न वेषो न सूर्यं न कूर्पं भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
na kaṇṭhī na pīṭhī na yaṣṭirna muṣṭirna vaṃśo na daṃśo na gaṇḍaḥ pragaṇḍaḥ.
na meṣo na veṣo na sūryaṃ na kūrpaṃ bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
na kaNThI na pIThI na yaSTirna muSTirna vaMzo na daMzo na gaNDaH pragaNDaH.
na meSo na veSo na sUryaM na kUrpaM bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
मृषा नो तृषा नो बुभुक्षा न शिष्या न विघ्नोत्सवामी न दण्डः प्रचण्डः।
न चूडा न चूडामणिर्नैव पीडा भजे तं प्रसिद्धं सदा शुद्धसिद्धम्॥
iast:
mṛṣā no tṛṣā no bubhukṣā na śiṣyā na vighnotsavāmī na daṇḍaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ.
na cūḍā na cūḍāmaṇirnaiva pīḍā bhaje taṃ prasiddhaṃ sadā śuddhasiddham..
hk:
mRSA no tRSA no bubhukSA na ziSyA na vighnotsavAmI na daNDaH pracaNDaH.
na cUDA na cUDAmaNirnaiva pIDA bhaje taM prasiddhaM sadA zuddhasiddham..

deva:
न शीतो न पीतो न तिक्तो कटुर्नो कषायो न चाऽऽम्लो न तिग्मः।
मृदुर्न कठोरो न रोगो न गुल्मः श्रिये श्रीजिनेन्द्रो नतेन्द्रो जितेन्द्रः॥
iast:
na śīto na pīto na tikto kaṭurno kaṣāyo na cā''mlo na tigmaḥ.
mṛdurna kaṭhoro na rogo na gulmaḥ śriye śrījinendro natendro jitendraḥ..
hk:
na zIto na pIto na tikto kaTurno kaSAyo na cA''mlo na tigmaH.
mRdurna kaThoro na rogo na gulmaH zriye zrIjinendro natendro jitendraH..

deva:
न दुर्गन्धको नो सुगन्धिर्न कृष्णो न नीलः सलीलो न बभ्रुर्न दभ्रः।
न दीर्घो न ह्रस्वो न पीनो न दीनः श्रिये श्रीजिनेन्द्रो नतेन्द्रो जितेन्द्रः॥
iast:
na durgandhako no sugandhirna kṛṣṇo na nīlaḥ salīlo na babhrurna dabhraḥ.
na dīrgho na hrasvo na pīno na dīnaḥ śriye śrījinendro natendro jitendraḥ..
hk:
na durgandhako no sugandhirna kRSNo na nIlaH salIlo na babhrurna dabhraH.
na dIrgho na hrasvo na pIno na dInaH zriye zrIjinendro natendro jitendraH..

deva:
न तुङ्गो न नीचो न कुब्जो विशालो न सान्द्रो न मन्द्रो न जीर्णो नवीनः।
न दूरं सनीडो न पूर्णो न चान्त्यः श्रिये श्रीजिनेन्द्रो नतेन्द्रो जितेन्द्रः॥
iast:
na tuṅgo na nīco na kubjo viśālo na sāndro na mandro na jīrṇo navīnaḥ.
na dūraṃ sanīḍo na pūrṇo na cāntyaḥ śriye śrījinendro natendro jitendraḥ..
hk:
na tuGgo na nIco na kubjo vizAlo na sAndro na mandro na jIrNo navInaH.
na dUraM sanIDo na pUrNo na cAntyaH zriye zrIjinendro natendro jitendraH..

deva:
न मत्तः प्रमत्तिर्न लोलो न गोलो न सव्योऽपसव्यो न गुप्तः प्रकाशः।
ऋजुर्नो न वक्रो न वृद्धो न बालः श्रिये श्रीजिनेन्द्रो नतेन्द्रो जितेन्द्रः॥
iast:
na mattaḥ pramattirna lolo na golo na savyo'pasavyo na guptaḥ prakāśaḥ.
ṛjurno na vakro na vṛddho na bālaḥ śriye śrījinendro natendro jitendraḥ..
hk:
na mattaH pramattirna lolo na golo na savyo'pasavyo na guptaH prakAzaH.
Rjurno na vakro na vRddho na bAlaH zriye zrIjinendro natendro jitendraH..

deva:
बाह्याऽबाह्यकर्मसम्बन्धतोऽमी भावा जीवेऽनेकशः सम्भवन्ति।
कर्माभावात्तन्निषेधेन सिद्धे रम्यं किञ्चिदुक्तं सतत्त्वम्॥
iast:
bāhyā'bāhyakarmasambandhato'mī bhāvā jīve'nekaśaḥ sambhavanti.
karmābhāvāttanniṣedhena siddhe ramyaṃ kiñciduktaṃ satattvam..
hk:
bAhyA'bAhyakarmasambandhato'mI bhAvA jIve'nekazaH sambhavanti.
karmAbhAvAttanniSedhena siddhe ramyaM kiJciduktaM satattvam..

deva:
वीर्यस्योद्यच्छर्मणो दर्शनस्य ज्ञानस्योच्चैर्नित्यमान्यं तमेव।
व्यक्तीभूतं कर्मणो विप्रयोगाद्धत्ते यस्तं सिद्धमीडे प्रशस्तम्॥
iast:
vīryasyodyaccharmaṇo darśanasya jñānasyoccairnityamānyaṃ tameva.
vyaktībhūtaṃ karmaṇo viprayogāddhatte yastaṃ siddhamīḍe praśastam..
hk:
vIryasyodyaccharmaNo darzanasya jJAnasyoccairnityamAnyaM tameva.
vyaktIbhUtaM karmaNo viprayogAddhatte yastaM siddhamIDe prazastam..

deva:
इति किमपि च तत्स्वरूपः तप्तः प्रगटनभङ्ग्या निवेशितः सिद्धः।
आनन्दघनोदयराजतेजसा प्रभवतु ज्ञानमयो हितः सुसिद्धः॥
iast:
iti kimapi ca tatsvarūpaḥ taptaḥ pragaṭanabhaṅgyā niveśitaḥ siddhaḥ.
ānandaghanodayarājatejasā prabhavatu jñānamayo hitaḥ susiddhaḥ..
hk:
iti kimapi ca tatsvarUpaH taptaH pragaTanabhaGgyA nivezitaH siddhaH.
AnandaghanodayarAjatejasA prabhavatu jJAnamayo hitaH susiddhaH..

deva:
भक्तामरप्रणतमौलिमणिप्रभाणामुद्योतकं दलितपापतमोवितानम्।
सम्यक् प्रणम्य जिनपादयुगं युगादावालम्बनं भवजले पततां जनानाम्॥१॥
iast:
bhaktāmarapraṇatamaulimaṇiprabhāṇāmudyotakaṃ dalitapāpatamovitānam.
samyak praṇamya jinapādayugaṃ yugādāvālambanaṃ bhavajale patatāṃ janānām..1..
hk:
bhaktAmarapraNatamaulimaNiprabhANAmudyotakaM dalitapApatamovitAnam.
samyak praNamya jinapAdayugaM yugAdAvAlambanaM bhavajale patatAM janAnAm..1..
translation: (vv. 1–2) Having duly bowed to the (holy) pair of Jina's [Lord Ṛṣabha's] feet – the feet which enhance the lustre of the jewels (set) in the crowns lowered by the devoted gods, which have destroyed the pitchy darkness of sins and which were in the beginning of the Yuga the (main) support of mankind sinking in the sea of existence [bhava], I [Mānatuṅga], too, will indeed praise that (very) first Lord of the Jinas, who has been extolled in hymns, lofty and captivating the hearts of (the living being of) the three worlds, by the lords of the celestial worlds, (– the lords) who had become proficient on the account of the insight they acquired by gaining the knowledge of the true principles of all the sciences.

deva:
यः संस्तुतः सकलवाङ्मयतत्त्वबोधादुद्भूतबुद्धिपटुभिः सुरलोकनाथैः।
स्तोत्रैर्जगत्त्रितयचित्तहरैरुदारैः स्तोष्ये किलाहमपि तं प्रथमं जिनेन्द्रम्॥२॥
iast:
yaḥ saṃstutaḥ sakalavāṅmayatattvabodhādudbhūtabuddhipaṭubhiḥ suralokanāthaiḥ.
stotrairjagattritayacittaharairudāraiḥ stoṣye kilāhamapi taṃ prathamaṃ jinendram..2..
hk:
yaH saMstutaH sakalavAGmayatattvabodhAdudbhUtabuddhipaTubhiH suralokanAthaiH.
stotrairjagattritayacittaharairudAraiH stoSye kilAhamapi taM prathamaM jinendram..2..

deva:
बुद्ध्या विनापि विबुधार्चितपादपीठ! स्तोतुं समुद्यतमतिर्विगतत्रपोऽहम्।
बालं विहाय जलसंस्थितमिन्दुबिम्बमन्यः क इच्छति जनः सहसा ग्रहीतुम्॥३॥
iast:
buddhyā vināpi vibudhārcitapādapīṭha! stotuṃ samudyatamatirvigatatrapo'ham.
bālaṃ vihāya jalasaṃsthitamindubimbamanyaḥ ka icchati janaḥ sahasā grahītum..3..
hk:
buddhyA vinApi vibudhArcitapAdapITha! stotuM samudyatamatirvigatatrapo'ham.
bAlaM vihAya jalasaMsthitamindubimbamanyaH ka icchati janaH sahasA grahItum..3..
translation: O Lord whose foot-stool is adorned by the wise (or the celestials), I (really) have become shameless for, though wanting in intelligence, I make an attempt at praising you. Who else than a child would hasten to catch the disc of the moon reflected in water?

deva:
वक्तुं गुणान् गुणसमुद्रशशाङ्ककान्तान् कस्ते क्षमः सुरगुरुप्रतिमोऽपि बुद्ध्या।
कल्पान्तकालपवनोद्धतनक्रचक्रं को वा तरीतुमलमम्बुनिधिं भुजाभ्याम्॥४॥
iast:
vaktuṃ guṇān guṇasamudraśaśāṅkakāntān kaste kṣamaḥ suragurupratimo'pi buddhyā.
kalpāntakālapavanoddhatanakracakraṃ ko vā tarītumalamambunidhiṃ bhujābhyām..4..
hk:
vaktuM guNAn guNasamudrazazAGkakAntAn kaste kSamaH suragurupratimo'pi buddhyA.
kalpAntakAlapavanoddhatanakracakraM ko vA tarItumalamambunidhiM bhujAbhyAm..4..
translation: O the ocean of virtues! Is even he who equals Bṛhaspati [the preceptor of gods] in knowledge capable of enumerating your merits that are charming like the moon? Who would be able to swim by the means of his hands the ocean in which the multitude of crocodiles (or Nakras and Cakras) are stirred up by the hurricane blowing at the time of the destructing of the universe [Kalpānta]?

deva:
सोऽहं तथापि तव भक्तिवशान्मुनीश! कर्तुं स्तवं विगतशक्तिरपि प्रवृत्तः।
प्रतीत्याऽऽत्मवीर्यमविचार्य मृगो मृगेन्द्रं नाभ्येति किं निजशिशोः परिपालनार्थम्॥५॥
iast:
so'haṃ tathāpi tava bhaktivaśānmunīśa! kartuṃ stavaṃ vigataśaktirapi pravṛttaḥ.
pratītyā''tmavīryamavicārya mṛgo mṛgendraṃ nābhyeti kiṃ nijaśiśoḥ paripālanārtham..5..
hk:
so'haM tathApi tava bhaktivazAnmunIza! kartuM stavaM vigatazaktirapi pravRttaH.
pratItyA''tmavIryamavicArya mRgo mRgendraM nAbhyeti kiM nijazizoH paripAlanArtham..5..
translation: O master of the saints! in spite of this, being induces by devotion, I, that very man, though powerless, proceed to praise you. Without being conscious of its power does not (even) an antelope rush against the king of beasts [lion] in order to protect its young one, owing to the affection it cherishes for it?

deva:
अल्पश्रुतं श्रुतवतां परिहासधाम त्वद्भक्तिरेव मुखरीकुरुते बलान्माम्।
यत् कोकिलः किल मधौ मधुरं विरौति तच्चारुचूतकलिकानिकरैकहेतुः॥६॥
iast:
alpaśrutaṃ śrutavatāṃ parihāsadhāma tvadbhaktireva mukharīkurute balānmām.
yat kokilaḥ kila madhau madhuraṃ virauti taccārucūtakalikānikaraikahetuḥ..6..
hk:
alpazrutaM zrutavatAM parihAsadhAma tvadbhaktireva mukharIkurute balAnmAm.
yat kokilaH kila madhau madhuraM virauti taccArucUtakalikAnikaraikahetuH..6..
translation: It is my devotion to you that compels me to prattle –me, who am an object of ridicule to the scholars on account of my possessing little knowledge. That the cuckoo sings sweet songs in the spring solely due to (the presence of) the charming bunches of mango-sprouts.

deva:
त्वत्संस्तवेन भवसन्ततिसन्निबद्धं पापं क्षणात् क्षयमुपैति शरीरभाजाम्।
आक्रान्तलोकमलिनीलमशेषमाशु सूर्यांशुभिन्नमिव शार्वरमन्धकारम्॥७॥
iast:
tvatsaṃstavena bhavasantatisannibaddhaṃ pāpaṃ kṣaṇāt kṣayamupaiti śarīrabhājām.
ākrāntalokamalinīlamaśeṣamāśu sūryāṃśubhinnamiva śārvaramandhakāram..7..
hk:
tvatsaMstavena bhavasantatisannibaddhaM pApaM kSaNAt kSayamupaiti zarIrabhAjAm.
AkrAntalokamalinIlamazeSamAzu sUryAMzubhinnamiva zArvaramandhakAram..7..
translation: The sins of the embodied souls accumulated within a series of births are instantaneously annihilated by praising you, as is the case with the jet-black nocturnal darkness pervading the universe, when pierced by the rays of the sun.

deva:
मत्वेति नाथ! तव संस्तवनं मयेदमारभ्यते तनुधियाऽपि तव प्रभावात्।
चेतो हरिष्यति सतां नलिनीदलेषु मुक्ताफलद्युतिमुपैति ननूदबिन्दुः॥८॥
iast:
matveti nātha! tava saṃstavanaṃ mayedamārabhyate tanudhiyā'pi tava prabhāvāt.
ceto hariṣyati satāṃ nalinīdaleṣu muktāphaladyutimupaiti nanūdabinduḥ..8..
hk:
matveti nAtha! tava saMstavanaM mayedamArabhyate tanudhiyA'pi tava prabhAvAt.
ceto hariSyati satAM nalinIdaleSu muktAphaladyutimupaiti nanUdabinduH..8..
translation: Having thus thought over, O Lord, I, though poor in intelligence commence (composing) this hymn of yours. Owing to your prowess, this (humble) work of mine will surely attract the attention of the good; (for, even) a drop of water shines like a pearl, when resting on a lead of lotus-plant.

deva:
आस्तां तव स्तवनमस्तसमस्तदोषं त्वत्सङ्कथाऽपि जगतां दुरितानि हन्ति।
दूरे सहस्रकिरणः कुरुते प्रभैव पद्माकरेषु जलजानि विकासभाञ्जि॥९॥
iast:
āstāṃ tava stavanamastasamastadoṣaṃ tvatsaṅkathā'pi jagatāṃ duritāni hanti.
dūre sahasrakiraṇaḥ kurute prabhaiva padmākareṣu jalajāni vikāsabhāñji..9..
hk:
AstAM tava stavanamastasamastadoSaM tvatsaGkathA'pi jagatAM duritAni hanti.
dUre sahasrakiraNaH kurute prabhaiva padmAkareSu jalajAni vikAsabhAJji..9..
translation: Let your psalm which has destroyed all faults be out of consideration since even the narration of your life annihilates the sins of the universe. Leave aside the case of the Sun, when (even) its light alone opens the lotuses lying in the lakes.

deva:
नात्यद्भुतं भुवनभूषणभूत! नाथ! भूतैर्गुणैर्भुवि भवन्तमभिष्टुवन्तः।
तुल्या भवन्ति भवतो ननु तेन किं वा भूत्याश्रितं य इह नात्मसमं करोति॥१०॥
iast:
nātyadbhutaṃ bhuvanabhūṣaṇabhūta! nātha! bhūtairguṇairbhuvi bhavantamabhiṣṭuvantaḥ.
tulyā bhavanti bhavato nanu tena kiṃ vā bhūtyāśritaṃ ya iha nātmasamaṃ karoti..10..
hk:
nAtyadbhutaM bhuvanabhUSaNabhUta! nAtha! bhUtairguNairbhuvi bhavantamabhiSTuvantaH.
tulyA bhavanti bhavato nanu tena kiM vA bhUtyAzritaM ya iha nAtmasamaM karoti..10..
translation: O Lord! O ornament of the universe! It is not the matter of great surprise that those who praise you on this earth by singing your really existing merits attain your status [become your equals]. Or else what is the use of him [that lord] who does not raise his devotee to the same level of prosperity where he is?

deva:
दृष्ट्वा भवन्तमनिमेषविलोकनीयं नान्यत्र तोषमुपयाति जनस्य चक्षुः।
पीत्वा पयः शशिकरद्युति दुग्धसिन्धोः क्षारं जलं जलनिधेरशितुं क इच्छेत्॥११॥
iast:
dṛṣṭvā bhavantamanimeṣavilokanīyaṃ nānyatra toṣamupayāti janasya cakṣuḥ.
pītvā payaḥ śaśikaradyuti dugdhasindhoḥ kṣāraṃ jalaṃ jalanidheraśituṃ ka icchet..11..
hk:
dRSTvA bhavantamanimeSavilokanIyaM nAnyatra toSamupayAti janasya cakSuH.
pItvA payaH zazikaradyuti dugdhasindhoH kSAraM jalaM jalanidherazituM ka icchet..11..
translation: After seeing your worthy to be unwinkingly looked at, the eye of a person does not find pleasure elsewhere. Who would desire to taste the brackish water of the sea, when once he has drunk the ilk of the milk-ocean shining like the rays of the moon?

deva:
यैः शान्तरागरुचिभिः परमाणुभिस्त्वं निर्मापितस्त्रिभुवनैकललामभूत!।
तावन्त एव खलु तेऽप्यणव पृथिव्यां यत् ते समानमपरं न हि रूपमस्ति॥१२॥
iast:
yaiḥ śāntarāgarucibhiḥ paramāṇubhistvaṃ nirmāpitastribhuvanaikalalāmabhūta!.
tāvanta eva khalu te'pyaṇava pṛthivyāṃ yat te samānamaparaṃ na hi rūpamasti..12..
hk:
yaiH zAntarAgarucibhiH paramANubhistvaM nirmApitastribhuvanaikalalAmabhUta!.
tAvanta eva khalu te'pyaNava pRthivyAM yat te samAnamaparaM na hi rUpamasti..12..
translation: O unique ornament of the forehead of the three worlds! Certainly, in the universe, there are only as many atoms possessing the sentiment of quietude as you are formed of; for, there is no other (being having) elegance like yours.

deva:
वक्त्रं क्व ते सुरनरोरगनेत्रहारि निःशेषनिर्जितजगत्त्रितयोपमानम्।
बिम्बं कलङ्कमलिनं क्व निशाकरस्य यद् वासरे भवति पाण्डुपलाशकल्पम्॥१३॥
iast:
vaktraṃ kva te suranaroraganetrahāri niḥśeṣanirjitajagattritayopamānam.
bimbaṃ kalaṅkamalinaṃ kva niśākarasya yad vāsare bhavati pāṇḍupalāśakalpam..13..
hk:
vaktraM kva te suranaroraganetrahAri niHzeSanirjitajagattritayopamAnam.
bimbaM kalaGkamalinaM kva nizAkarasya yad vAsare bhavati pANDupalAzakalpam..13..
translation: Where is your face which attracts the eyes of the celestials, the human-beings and the serpent-gods and which far excels all the standards of comparison to be found in the three worlds? And where is the disc of the moon which is stained with a blot and which grows pale-white like a lead of the Palāśa tree by daybreak?

deva:
सम्पूर्णमण्डलशशाङ्ककलाकलापशुभ्रा गुणस्त्रिभुवनं तव लङ्घयन्ति।
ये संश्रितास्त्रिजगदीश्वर! नाथमेकं कस्तान् निवारयति सञ्चरतो यथेष्टम्॥१४॥
iast:
sampūrṇamaṇḍalaśaśāṅkakalākalāpaśubhrā guṇastribhuvanaṃ tava laṅghayanti.
ye saṃśritāstrijagadīśvara! nāthamekaṃ kastān nivārayati sañcarato yatheṣṭam..14..
hk:
sampUrNamaNDalazazAGkakalAkalApazubhrA guNastribhuvanaM tava laGghayanti.
ye saMzritAstrijagadIzvara! nAthamekaM kastAn nivArayati saJcarato yatheSTam..14..
translation: O master of the three worlds! Your virtues shining like the collection of the digits of the moon having a complete disc are not contained in the three worlds. Who can prevent from walking freely those that have chosen you as their sole master?

deva:
चित्रं किमत्र यदि ते त्रिदशाङ्गनाभिर्नीतं मनागपि मनो न विकारमार्गम्।
कल्पान्तकालमरुताचलिताचलेन किं मन्दराद्रिशिखरं चलितं कदाचित्॥१५॥
iast:
citraṃ kimatra yadi te tridaśāṅganābhirnītaṃ manāgapi mano na vikāramārgam.
kalpāntakālamarutācalitācalena kiṃ mandarādriśikharaṃ calitaṃ kadācit..15..
hk:
citraM kimatra yadi te tridazAGganAbhirnItaM manAgapi mano na vikAramArgam.
kalpAntakAlamarutAcalitAcalena kiM mandarAdrizikharaM calitaM kadAcit..15..
translation: What is there to wonder at, if the celestial nymphs could not diver your mind towards the path of passions even in the least? Can the peak of Mandara [Meru] mountain be ever moved by the wind blowing at the time of the destruction of the universe–the wind which shakes the other mountains?

deva:
निर्धूमवर्तिरपवर्जिततैलपूरः कृत्स्नं जगत्त्रयमिदं प्रकटीकरोषि।
गम्यो न जातु मरुतां चलिताचलानां दीपोऽपरस्त्वमसि नाथ! जगत्प्रकाशः॥१६॥
iast:
nirdhūmavartirapavarjitatailapūraḥ kṛtsnaṃ jagattrayamidaṃ prakaṭīkaroṣi.
gamyo na jātu marutāṃ calitācalānāṃ dīpo'parastvamasi nātha! jagatprakāśaḥ..16..
hk:
nirdhUmavartirapavarjitatailapUraH kRtsnaM jagattrayamidaM prakaTIkaroSi.
gamyo na jAtu marutAM calitAcalAnAM dIpo'parastvamasi nAtha! jagatprakAzaH..16..
translation: O Lord! You are the supernatural lamp, the light of the world–the lamp which is free from smoke (of aversion), wherein there is no wick (of lust), which does not require to be filled up with oil (of attachment), which completely illumines the three worlds (in virtue of omniscience) and which is unassailable by the winds (or gods) that move the mountains.

deva:
नास्तं कदाचिदुपयासि न राहुगम्यः स्पष्टीकरोषि सहसा युगपज्जगन्ति।
नाम्भोधरोदरनिरुद्धमहाप्रभावः सूर्यातिशायि महिमाऽसि मुनीन्द्र! लोके॥१७॥
iast:
nāstaṃ kadācidupayāsi na rāhugamyaḥ spaṣṭīkaroṣi sahasā yugapajjaganti.
nāmbhodharodaraniruddhamahāprabhāvaḥ sūryātiśāyi mahimā'si munīndra! loke..17..
hk:
nAstaM kadAcidupayAsi na rAhugamyaH spaSTIkaroSi sahasA yugapajjaganti.
nAmbhodharodaraniruddhamahAprabhAvaH sUryAtizAyi mahimA'si munIndra! loke..17..
translation: O Lord of the ascetics! In this world you surpassed the sun in greatness. Form neither do you ever set, nor are you accessible to Rāhu; (moreover) all of a sudden you illumine all the worlds simultaneously and your immense prowess is not obstructed by the intervention of the clouds.

deva:
नित्योदयं दलितमोहमहान्धकारं गम्यं न राहुवदनस्य न वारिदानाम्।
विभ्राजते तव मुखाब्जमनल्पकान्ति विद्योतयज्जगदपूर्वशशाङ्कबिम्बम्॥१८॥
iast:
nityodayaṃ dalitamohamahāndhakāraṃ gamyaṃ na rāhuvadanasya na vāridānām.
vibhrājate tava mukhābjamanalpakānti vidyotayajjagadapūrvaśaśāṅkabimbam..18..
hk:
nityodayaM dalitamohamahAndhakAraM gamyaM na rAhuvadanasya na vAridAnAm.
vibhrAjate tava mukhAbjamanalpakAnti vidyotayajjagadapUrvazazAGkabimbam..18..
translation: Your lotus-like face shines like the disc of an extra-ordinary Moon; for, it has a perpetual rise (as it never sets), has destroyed the pitch darkness of infatuation, is never within the reach of Rāhu or clouds, possesses immense lustre and illuminates the world.

deva:
किं शर्वरीषु शशिनाऽह्नि विवस्वता वा युष्मन्मुखेन्दुदलितेषु तमस्सु नाथ!।
निष्पन्नशालिवनशालिनि जीवलोके कार्यं कियज्जलधरैर्जलभारनम्रैः॥१९॥
iast:
kiṃ śarvarīṣu śaśinā'hni vivasvatā vā yuṣmanmukhendudaliteṣu tamassu nātha!.
niṣpannaśālivanaśālini jīvaloke kāryaṃ kiyajjaladharairjalabhāranamraiḥ..19..
hk:
kiM zarvarISu zazinA'hni vivasvatA vA yuSmanmukhendudaliteSu tamassu nAtha!.
niSpannazAlivanazAlini jIvaloke kAryaM kiyajjaladharairjalabhAranamraiH..19..
translation: What is the use of the Moon at night and what use is there of the Sun by day, when O Lord! Your Moon-like face destroys darkness (of ignorance)? What necessity is there of the clouds surcharges with water [lit. bent down by the burden of water], when the (mortal) world is (already) resplendent with the fields of the fully grown Śāli rice?

deva:
ज्ञानं यथा त्वयि विभाति कृतावकाशं नैवं तथा हरिहरादिषु नायकेषु।
तेजः स्फुरन् मणिषु याति यथा महत्त्वं नैवं तु काचशकले किरणाकुलेऽपि॥२०॥
iast:
jñānaṃ yathā tvayi vibhāti kṛtāvakāśaṃ naivaṃ tathā hariharādiṣu nāyakeṣu.
tejaḥ sphuran maṇiṣu yāti yathā mahattvaṃ naivaṃ tu kācaśakale kiraṇākule'pi..20..
hk:
jJAnaM yathA tvayi vibhAti kRtAvakAzaM naivaM tathA hariharAdiSu nAyakeSu.
tejaH sphuran maNiSu yAti yathA mahattvaM naivaM tu kAcazakale kiraNAkule'pi..20..
translation: Knowledge ( which illumines all the objects ) does not shine with so great an effulgence in the case of Hari (Viṣṇu), Hara (Śiva) and others, the lords (of the followers of other systems of philosophy) as it does when it resorts to yours [lit. when it finds a place in you]. Light attains its magnificence, when it falls on the sparkling jewels; but it fails to attain the same (sort of magnificence), when it falls on a piece of glass, even if it be pervaded by the rays of light.

deva:
मन्ये वरं हरिहरादय एव दृष्टा दृष्टेषु येषु हृदयं त्वयि तोषमेति।
किं वीक्षितेन भवता भुवि येन नान्यः कश्चिन्मनो हरति नाथ! भवान्तरेऽपि॥२१॥
iast:
manye varaṃ hariharādaya eva dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭeṣu yeṣu hṛdayaṃ tvayi toṣameti.
kiṃ vīkṣitena bhavatā bhuvi yena nānyaḥ kaścinmano harati nātha! bhavāntare'pi..21..
hk:
manye varaM hariharAdaya eva dRSTA dRSTeSu yeSu hRdayaM tvayi toSameti.
kiM vIkSitena bhavatA bhuvi yena nAnyaH kazcinmano harati nAtha! bhavAntare'pi..21..
translation: I believe that it was for the better that (first of all) I verily saw Hari, Hara and the like; (for) as I have already seen them, my heart gets complete satisfaction on seeing you. What has been the result of seeing you? (The reply is that) O Lord! No one else in this world will be able to divert my mind from you even in the next birth.

deva:
स्त्रीणां शतानि शतशो जनयन्ति पुत्रान् नान्या सुतं त्वदुपमं जननी प्रसूता।
सर्वा दिशो दधति भानि सहस्ररश्मिं प्राच्येव दिग् जनयति स्फुरदंशुजालम्॥२२॥
iast:
strīṇāṃ śatāni śataśo janayanti putrān nānyā sutaṃ tvadupamaṃ jananī prasūtā.
sarvā diśo dadhati bhāni sahasraraśmiṃ prācyeva dig janayati sphuradaṃśujālam..22..
hk:
strINAM zatAni zatazo janayanti putrAn nAnyA sutaM tvadupamaM jananI prasUtA.
sarvA dizo dadhati bhAni sahasrarazmiM prAcyeva dig janayati sphuradaMzujAlam..22..
translation: Hundreds of women give birth to hundreds of sons; but no mother (except yours) gave birth to a son that  could stand (out in) comparison with yours. In all the directions there are [lit. all the quarters contain] constellations; but it is only the east which brings firth the Sun having a collection of resplendent rays.

deva:
त्वामामनन्ति मुनयः परमं पुमांसमादित्यवर्णममलं तमसः परस्तात्।
त्वामेव सम्यगुपलभ्य जयन्ति मृत्युं नान्यः शिवः शिवपदस्य मुनीन्द्र! पन्थाः॥२३॥
iast:
tvāmāmananti munayaḥ paramaṃ pumāṃsamādityavarṇamamalaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt.
tvāmeva samyagupalabhya jayanti mṛtyuṃ nānyaḥ śivaḥ śivapadasya munīndra! panthāḥ..23..
hk:
tvAmAmananti munayaH paramaM pumAMsamAdityavarNamamalaM tamasaH parastAt.
tvAmeva samyagupalabhya jayanti mRtyuM nAnyaH zivaH zivapadasya munIndra! panthAH..23..
translation: O Lord of the ascetics! The sages give you the noble appellation of the Supreme Being having the colour of the sun, bright and inaccessible to darkness and free from blemishes. They conquer death by duly realizing yours alone; (for) there is no other beneficial path leading to the auspicious abode [liberation].

deva:
त्वामव्ययं विभुमचिन्त्यमसङ्ख्यमाद्यं ब्रह्माणमीश्वरमनन्तमनङ्गकेतुम्।
योगीश्वरं विदितयोगमनेकमेकं ज्ञानस्वरूपममलं प्रवदन्ति सन्तः॥२४॥
iast:
tvāmavyayaṃ vibhumacintyamasaṅkhyamādyaṃ brahmāṇamīśvaramanantamanaṅgaketum.
yogīśvaraṃ viditayogamanekamekaṃ jñānasvarūpamamalaṃ pravadanti santaḥ..24..
hk:
tvAmavyayaM vibhumacintyamasaGkhyamAdyaM brahmANamIzvaramanantamanaGgaketum.
yogIzvaraM viditayogamanekamekaM jJAnasvarUpamamalaM pravadanti santaH..24..
translation: The good declare you as imperishable, omnipresent (or powerful), incomprehensible, innumerable (or free from wars), first (in position and time), Brahman, Īśvara, infinite, the comet in destroying the Cupid, the master of Yogins, well-versed in Yoga, many, one, the embodiment of knowledge and pure.

deva:
बुद्धस्त्वमेव विबुधार्चितबुद्धिबोधात् त्वं शङ्करोऽसि भुवनत्रयशङ्करत्वात्।
धाताऽसि धीर! शिवमार्गविधेर्विधानाद् व्यक्तं त्वमेव भगवन्! पुरुषोत्तमोऽसि॥२५॥
iast:
buddhastvameva vibudhārcitabuddhibodhāt tvaṃ śaṅkaro'si bhuvanatrayaśaṅkaratvāt.
dhātā'si dhīra! śivamārgavidhervidhānād vyaktaṃ tvameva bhagavan! puruṣottamo'si..25..
hk:
buddhastvameva vibudhArcitabuddhibodhAt tvaM zaGkaro'si bhuvanatrayazaGkaratvAt.
dhAtA'si dhIra! zivamArgavidhervidhAnAd vyaktaM tvameva bhagavan! puruSottamo'si..25..
translation: You alone are Buddha, because the gods have worshipped the enlightenment of your knowledge. There is no other Śaṅkara than you, for you (alone) bestow happiness to the three worlds. O Intelligent Being! You alone are the creator (Brahman); for, you have pointed out the path leading to liberation. O Divine Being! it is quite evident that you alon are the best of men [Puruṣottama i.e. Nārāyaṇa].

deva:
तुभ्यं नमस्त्रिभुवनार्तिहराय नाथ! तुभ्यं नमः क्षितितलामलभूषणाय।
तुभ्यं नमस्त्रिगतः परमेश्वराय तुभ्यं नमो जिन! भवोदधिशोषणाय॥२६॥
iast:
tubhyaṃ namastribhuvanārtiharāya nātha! tubhyaṃ namaḥ kṣititalāmalabhūṣaṇāya.
tubhyaṃ namastrigataḥ parameśvarāya tubhyaṃ namo jina! bhavodadhiśoṣaṇāya..26..
hk:
tubhyaM namastribhuvanArtiharAya nAtha! tubhyaM namaH kSititalAmalabhUSaNAya.
tubhyaM namastrigataH paramezvarAya tubhyaM namo jina! bhavodadhizoSaNAya..26..
translation: O Lord! Obeisance to you, the destroyer of the miseries of the three worlds. Obeisance to you, the pure jewel on the surface of the earth (or the unsullied ornament of the mortal, nether and celestial worlds). Obeisance to you, the Supreme Lord of the three worlds. O Jina! adoration to you that has dried up the ocean of mundane existence.

deva:
को विस्मयोऽत्र यदि नाम गुणैरशेषैस्त्वं संश्रितो निरवकाशतया मुनीश!।
दोषैरुपात्तविविधाश्रयजातगर्वैः स्वप्नान्तरेऽपि न कदाचिदपेक्षितोऽसि॥२७॥
iast:
ko vismayo'tra yadi nāma guṇairaśeṣaistvaṃ saṃśrito niravakāśatayā munīśa!.
doṣairupāttavividhāśrayajātagarvaiḥ svapnāntare'pi na kadācidapekṣito'si..27..
hk:
ko vismayo'tra yadi nAma guNairazeSaistvaM saMzrito niravakAzatayA munIza!.
doSairupAttavividhAzrayajAtagarvaiH svapnAntare'pi na kadAcidapekSito'si..27..
translation: O Lord of the ascetics! What wonder is there, if you are wholly resorted to by all the virtues and that you are not seen even in a dream by vices which are puffed up with pride owing to the manifold shelter that they found elsewhere?

deva:
उच्चैरशोकतरुसंश्रितमुन्मयूखमाभाति रूपममलं भवतो नितान्तम्।
स्पष्टोल्लसत्किरणमस्ततमोवितानं बिम्बं रवेरिव पयोधरपार्श्ववर्ति॥२८॥
iast:
uccairaśokatarusaṃśritamunmayūkhamābhāti rūpamamalaṃ bhavato nitāntam.
spaṣṭollasatkiraṇamastatamovitānaṃ bimbaṃ raveriva payodharapārśvavarti..28..
hk:
uccairazokatarusaMzritamunmayUkhamAbhAti rUpamamalaM bhavato nitAntam.
spaSTollasatkiraNamastatamovitAnaM bimbaM raveriva payodharapArzvavarti..28..
translation: Your defectless [perfect] figure which has resorted to the lofty Aśoka tree and from which lustre emanates shrines in full effulgence like the disc of the Sun lying adjacent to a cloud–the disc which possess clear and splendid beams and which has dispelled the mass of darkness.

deva:
सिंहासने मणिमयूखशिखाविचित्रे विभ्राजते तव वपुः कनकावदातम्।
बिम्बं वियद्विलसदंशुलतावितानं तुङ्गोदयाद्रिशिरसीव सहस्ररश्मेः॥२९॥
iast:
siṃhāsane maṇimayūkhaśikhāvicitre vibhrājate tava vapuḥ kanakāvadātam.
bimbaṃ viyadvilasadaṃśulatāvitānaṃ tuṅgodayādriśirasīva sahasraraśmeḥ..29..
hk:
siMhAsane maNimayUkhazikhAvicitre vibhrAjate tava vapuH kanakAvadAtam.
bimbaM viyadvilasadaMzulatAvitAnaM tuGgodayAdrizirasIva sahasrarazmeH..29..
translation: Your body (resting) on the lion-throne variegated by the (radiance of the) pencil of rays of jewels and beautiful (or yellow) like gold shines like the disc of the Sun on the high summit of the sun-rise-mountain–the disc having the collection of its branch-like rays spreading in the sky.

deva:
कुन्दावदातचलचामरचारुशोभं विभ्राजते तव वपुः कलधौतकान्तम्।
उद्यच्छशाङ्कशुचिनिर्झरवारिधारमुच्चैस्तटं सुरगिरेरिव शातकौम्भम्॥३०॥
iast:
kundāvadātacalacāmaracāruśobhaṃ vibhrājate tava vapuḥ kaladhautakāntam.
udyacchaśāṅkaśucinirjharavāridhāramuccaistaṭaṃ suragireriva śātakaumbham..30..
hk:
kundAvadAtacalacAmaracAruzobhaM vibhrAjate tava vapuH kaladhautakAntam.
udyacchazAGkazucinirjharavAridhAramuccaistaTaM suragireriva zAtakaumbham..30..
translation: Your body which is lovely like gold and which possess fascinating beauty owing to the moving chowries white like the jasmine flowers, shines like the top-most golden peak of the mountain of gods [Meru] from which the water-falls pure like the rising moon are gurgling.

deva:
छत्रत्रयं तव विभाति शशाङ्ककान्तमुच्चैः स्थितं स्थगितभानुकरप्रतापम्।
मुक्ताफलप्रकरजालविवृद्धशोभं प्रख्यापयत् त्रिजगतः परमेश्वरत्वम्॥३१॥
iast:
chatratrayaṃ tava vibhāti śaśāṅkakāntamuccaiḥ sthitaṃ sthagitabhānukarapratāpam.
muktāphalaprakarajālavivṛddhaśobhaṃ prakhyāpayat trijagataḥ parameśvaratvam..31..
hk:
chatratrayaM tava vibhAti zazAGkakAntamuccaiH sthitaM sthagitabhAnukarapratApam.
muktAphalaprakarajAlavivRddhazobhaM prakhyApayat trijagataH paramezvaratvam..31..
translation: Your three canopies which are lying above (your head), which are beautiful like the Moon, which have (even) eclipsed the light (or have remove the excessive heat) of the rays of the Sun and whose beauty is enhances by a zone of pearls and which proclaim your supremacy over the three worlds are resplendent.

deva:
उन्निन्द्रहेमनवपङ्कजपुञ्जकान्तिपर्युल्लन्नखमयूखशिखाभिरामौ।
पादौ पदानि तव यत्र जिनेन्द्र! धत्तः पद्मानि तत्र विबुधाः परिकल्पयन्ति॥३२॥
iast:
unnindrahemanavapaṅkajapuñjakāntiparyullannakhamayūkhaśikhābhirāmau.
pādau padāni tava yatra jinendra! dhattaḥ padmāni tatra vibudhāḥ parikalpayanti..32..
hk:
unnindrahemanavapaGkajapuJjakAntiparyullannakhamayUkhazikhAbhirAmau.
pAdau padAni tava yatra jinendra! dhattaH padmAni tatra vibudhAH parikalpayanti..32..
translation: O Lord of the Jinas! The gods create (nine) lotuses wherever the footprints are formed by your feet which are attractive on account of the pencil of rays issuing from your nails shining with the splendour of the cluster of the blooming golden fresh (or nine) lotuses.

deva:
इत्थं यथा तव विभूतिरभूज्जिनेन्द्र! धर्मोपदेशनविधौ न तथा परस्य।
यादृक् प्रभा दिनकृतः प्रहतान्धकारा तादृक् कुतो ग्रहगणस्य विकाशिनोऽपि॥३३॥
iast:
itthaṃ yathā tava vibhūtirabhūjjinendra! dharmopadeśanavidhau na tathā parasya.
yādṛk prabhā dinakṛtaḥ prahatāndhakārā tādṛk kuto grahagaṇasya vikāśino'pi..33..
hk:
itthaM yathA tava vibhUtirabhUjjinendra! dharmopadezanavidhau na tathA parasya.
yAdRk prabhA dinakRtaH prahatAndhakArA tAdRk kuto grahagaNasya vikAzino'pi..33..
translation: O Lord of the Jinas! No other being can attain the above-described grandeur of yours which you possess at the time of preaching religion. (For), when can the light of a group of constellations, though shining, match with the lustre of the sun by which darkness is destroyed?

deva:
श्च्योतन्मदाविलविलोलकपोलमूलमत्तभ्रमद्भ्रमरनादविवृद्धकोपम्।
ऐरावताभमिभमुद्धतमापतन्तं दृष्ट्वा भयं भवति नो भवदाश्रितानाम्॥३४॥
iast:
ścyotanmadāvilavilolakapolamūlamattabhramadbhramaranādavivṛddhakopam.
airāvatābhamibhamuddhatamāpatantaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayaṃ bhavati no bhavadāśritānām..34..
hk:
zcyotanmadAvilavilolakapolamUlamattabhramadbhramaranAdavivRddhakopam.
airAvatAbhamibhamuddhatamApatantaM dRSTvA bhayaM bhavati no bhavadAzritAnAm..34..
translation: Those who resort to you are not terrified when they see a wild elephant comparable with Airāvata rushing against them–the elephant whose anger is increased by the humming of the bees which are madly whirling round their restless temples soiled with the trickling rut.

deva:
भिन्नेभकुम्भगलदुज्ज्वलशोणिताक्तमुक्ताफलप्रकरभूषितभूमिभागः।
बद्धक्रमः क्रमगतं हरिणाधिपोऽपि नाक्रामति क्रमयुगाचलसंश्रितं ते॥३५॥
iast:
bhinnebhakumbhagaladujjvalaśoṇitāktamuktāphalaprakarabhūṣitabhūmibhāgaḥ.
baddhakramaḥ kramagataṃ hariṇādhipo'pi nākrāmati kramayugācalasaṃśritaṃ te..35..
hk:
bhinnebhakumbhagaladujjvalazoNitAktamuktAphalaprakarabhUSitabhUmibhAgaH.
baddhakramaH kramagataM hariNAdhipo'pi nAkrAmati kramayugAcalasaMzritaM te..35..
translation: The lion who is about to pounce upon and who has adorned the ground by scattering on it a collection of pearls besmeared with the bright blood issuing forth fromm the temples of the elephants torn by him, does not attack him, who has resorted to the mountain (in the form) of the pair of your feet, even though he is within his clutches.

deva:
कल्पान्तकालपवनोद्धतवह्निकल्पं दावानलं ज्वलितमुज्ज्वलमुत्फुलिङ्गम्।
विश्वं जिघत्सुमिव सम्मुखमापतन्तं त्वन्नामकीर्तनजलं शमयत्यशेषम्॥३६॥
iast:
kalpāntakālapavanoddhatavahnikalpaṃ dāvānalaṃ jvalitamujjvalamutphuliṅgam.
viśvaṃ jighatsumiva sammukhamāpatantaṃ tvannāmakīrtanajalaṃ śamayatyaśeṣam..36..
hk:
kalpAntakAlapavanoddhatavahnikalpaM dAvAnalaM jvalitamujjvalamutphuliGgam.
vizvaM jighatsumiva sammukhamApatantaM tvannAmakIrtanajalaM zamayatyazeSam..36..
translation: The water (in the form) of mentioning your name completely extinguishes the conflagration which resembles the fire kindled by the hurricane (furiously blowing) at the time of the destruction of the world, which is fully ablaze and bright and from which flash forth the sparks and which approaches as if with a desire to swallow the entire universe.

deva:
रक्तेक्षणं समदकोकिलकण्ठनीलं क्रोधोद्धतं फणिनमुत्फणमापतन्तम्।
आक्रामति क्रमयुगेन निरस्तशङ्कस्त्वन्नामनागदमनी हृदि यस्य पुंसः॥३७॥
iast:
raktekṣaṇaṃ samadakokilakaṇṭhanīlaṃ krodhoddhataṃ phaṇinamutphaṇamāpatantam.
ākrāmati kramayugena nirastaśaṅkastvannāmanāgadamanī hṛdi yasya puṃsaḥ..37..
hk:
raktekSaNaM samadakokilakaNThanIlaM krodhoddhataM phaNinamutphaNamApatantam.
AkrAmati kramayugena nirastazaGkastvannAmanAgadamanI hRdi yasya puMsaH..37..
translation: That man in whose heart rests the snake-charm (Nāga-damanī) of your name fearlessly treads upon a a red-eyed cobra, which is as black as the throat of intoxicated cuckoo wild with rage and which is rushing forth with its hood raised up.

deva:
वल्गत्तुरङ्गगजगर्जितभीमनादमाजौ बलं बलवतामपि भूपतीनाम्।
उद्यद्दिवाकरमयूखशिखापविद्धं त्वत्कीर्तनात् तम इवाशु भिदामुपैति॥३८॥
iast:
valgatturaṅgagajagarjitabhīmanādamājau balaṃ balavatāmapi bhūpatīnām.
udyaddivākaramayūkhaśikhāpaviddhaṃ tvatkīrtanāt tama ivāśu bhidāmupaiti..38..
hk:
valgatturaGgagajagarjitabhImanAdamAjau balaM balavatAmapi bhUpatInAm.
udyaddivAkaramayUkhazikhApaviddhaM tvatkIrtanAt tama ivAzu bhidAmupaiti..38..
translation: The army of even mighty monarchs, wherein the horses are running at full gallop and wherein the elephants are making tremendous noise by roaring, is immediately destroyed on the battlefield by praising you like the darkness when peirced by the sharp ends of rays of the rising sun.

deva:
कुन्ताग्रभिन्नगजशोणितवारिवाहवेगावतारतरणातुरयोधभीमे।
युद्धे जयं विजितदुर्जयजेयपक्षास्त्वत्पादपङ्कजवनाश्रयिणो लभन्ते॥३९॥
iast:
kuntāgrabhinnagajaśoṇitavārivāhavegāvatārataraṇāturayodhabhīme.
yuddhe jayaṃ vijitadurjayajeyapakṣāstvatpādapaṅkajavanāśrayiṇo labhante..39..
hk:
kuntAgrabhinnagajazoNitavArivAhavegAvatArataraNAturayodhabhIme.
yuddhe jayaM vijitadurjayajeyapakSAstvatpAdapaGkajavanAzrayiNo labhante..39..
translation: Those who take shelter under the lotus-grove of your feet gain victory by vanquishing the unconquerable enemies in the war which is horrible on account of the warriors being impatient to cross the powerful streams of blood gushing forth from (the temples of) the elephants pierced by the pointed ends of lances.

deva:
अम्भोनिधौ क्षुभितभीषणनक्रचक्रपाठीनपीठभयदोल्बणवाडवाग्नौ।
रङ्गत्तरङ्गशिखरस्थितयानपात्रास्त्रासं विहाय भवतः स्मरणाद् व्रजन्ति॥४०॥
iast:
ambhonidhau kṣubhitabhīṣaṇanakracakrapāṭhīnapīṭhabhayadolbaṇavāḍavāgnau.
raṅgattaraṅgaśikharasthitayānapātrāstrāsaṃ vihāya bhavataḥ smaraṇād vrajanti..40..
hk:
ambhonidhau kSubhitabhISaNanakracakrapAThInapIThabhayadolbaNavADavAgnau.
raGgattaraGgazikharasthitayAnapAtrAstrAsaM vihAya bhavataH smaraNAd vrajanti..40..
translation: Those who remember you fearlessly reach (the shore,) even when they are sailing in a vessel floating on the tops of the rising billows in the ocean which is the abode of a manifest submarine fire and of the hosts of the ferocious and excited crocodiles and alligators.

deva:
उद्भूतभीषणजलोदरभारभुग्नाः शोच्यां दशामुपगताश्च्युतजीविताशाः।
त्वत्पादपङ्कजरजोऽमृतदिग्धदेहा मर्त्या भवन्ति मकरध्वजतुल्यरूपाः॥४१॥
iast:
udbhūtabhīṣaṇajalodarabhārabhugnāḥ śocyāṃ daśāmupagatāścyutajīvitāśāḥ.
tvatpādapaṅkajarajo'mṛtadigdhadehā martyā bhavanti makaradhvajatulyarūpāḥ..41..
hk:
udbhUtabhISaNajalodarabhArabhugnAH zocyAM dazAmupagatAzcyutajIvitAzAH.
tvatpAdapaGkajarajo'mRtadigdhadehA martyA bhavanti makaradhvajatulyarUpAH..41..
translation: The mortals, who are bent down under the burden of dreadful dropsy that has arisen, who are reduced to a deplorable condition and who have lost all hopes of surviving become Cupid-like in beauty, when they anoint their body with the ambrosia of the pollen of the lotuses (in the form) of your feet.

deva:
आपादकण्ठमुरुशृङ्खलवेष्टिताङ्गा गाढं बृहन्निबिडकोटिनिघृष्टजङ्घाः।
त्वन्नाममन्त्रमनिशं मनुजाः स्मरन्तः सद्यः स्वयं विगतबन्धभया भवन्ति॥४२॥
iast:
āpādakaṇṭhamuruśṛṅkhalaveṣṭitāṅgā gāḍhaṃ bṛhannibiḍakoṭinighṛṣṭajaṅghāḥ.
tvannāmamantramaniśaṃ manujāḥ smarantaḥ sadyaḥ svayaṃ vigatabandhabhayā bhavanti..42..
hk:
ApAdakaNThamuruzRGkhalaveSTitAGgA gADhaM bRhannibiDakoTinighRSTajaGghAH.
tvannAmamantramanizaM manujAH smarantaH sadyaH svayaM vigatabandhabhayA bhavanti..42..
translation: Those men whose limbs are clothed from foot to neck in heavy fetters and whose shanks are severely skinned by millions of strong chains, automatically become at once free from the fear of bondage by always meditating upon your name as mantra.

deva:
मत्तद्विपेन्द्रमृगराजदवानलाहिसङ्ग्रामवारिधिमहोदरबन्धनोत्थम्।
तस्याशु नाशमुपयाति भयं भियेव यस्तावकं स्तवमिमं मतिमानधीते॥४३॥
iast:
mattadvipendramṛgarājadavānalāhisaṅgrāmavāridhimahodarabandhanottham.
tasyāśu nāśamupayāti bhayaṃ bhiyeva yastāvakaṃ stavamimaṃ matimānadhīte..43..
hk:
mattadvipendramRgarAjadavAnalAhisaGgrAmavAridhimahodarabandhanottham.
tasyAzu nAzamupayAti bhayaM bhiyeva yastAvakaM stavamimaM matimAnadhIte..43..
translation: The danger arising from (1) the intoxicated lordly elephants, (2) the kings of beasts (lions), (3) conflagrations, (4) serpents, (5) wars, (6) oceans, (7) dropsy and (8) confinements speedily disappears as if through fear in the case of that talented man who recited this hymn in your praise.

deva:
स्तोत्रस्रजं तवजिनेन्द्रगुणैर्निबद्धां भक्त्या मया रुचिरवर्णविचित्रपुष्पाम्।
धत्ते जनो य इह कण्ठगतामजस्रं तं मानतुङ्गमवशा समुपैति लक्ष्मीः॥४४॥
iast:
stotrasrajaṃ tavajinendraguṇairnibaddhāṃ bhaktyā mayā ruciravarṇavicitrapuṣpām.
dhatte jano ya iha kaṇṭhagatāmajasraṃ taṃ mānatuṅgamavaśā samupaiti lakṣmīḥ..44..
hk:
stotrasrajaM tavajinendraguNairnibaddhAM bhaktyA mayA ruciravarNavicitrapuSpAm.
dhatte jano ya iha kaNThagatAmajasraM taM mAnatuGgamavazA samupaiti lakSmIH..44..
translation: O master of the Jinas! The goddess of wealth spontaneously awaits on that Mānatuṅga who, in this world incessantly wears around his neck the garland of prayer prepared by me with devotion, the garland which is knitted with your merits and which has variegated flowers of attractive (colours in the form of) beautiful letters.

deva:
अमरगिरिगरीयो मारुदेवीयदेहे
कुवलयदलमालाकोमला कुन्तलाली।
सजलजलदपावन्नु सन्नीलकण्ठी
धवनिवहमनन्दं नन्दयन्ती जयाय॥
iast:
amaragirigarīyo mārudevīyadehe
kuvalayadalamālākomalā kuntalālī.
sajalajaladapāvannu sannīlakaṇṭhī
dhavanivahamanandaṃ nandayantī jayāya..
hk:
amaragirigarIyo mArudevIyadehe
kuvalayadalamAlAkomalA kuntalAlI.
sajalajaladapAvannu sannIlakaNThI
dhavanivahamanandaM nandayantI jayAya..

deva:
असमसमरलीलालालसाभावरूप-
च्छलपरिबलहेलाभङ्गरङ्गंगमीव।
करिवरपरिधारी वो विमोहावहारी
भवजयिविजयाभू रङ्गभूमि रमासु॥
iast:
asamasamaralīlālālasābhāvarūpa-
cchalaparibalahelābhaṅgaraṅgaṃgamīva.
karivaraparidhārī vo vimohāvahārī
bhavajayivijayābhū raṅgabhūmi ramāsu..
hk:
asamasamaralIlAlAlasAbhAvarUpa-
cchalaparibalahelAbhaGgaraGgaMgamIva.
karivaraparidhArI vo vimohAvahArI
bhavajayivijayAbhU raGgabhUmi ramAsu..

deva:
भविविभुमभिवन्दे संभवं संभवन्तं
निबिडजडिमभङ्गेऽभङ्गरङ्गेण गेयम्।
तरणिहयवरेणाबद्धसेवं विबोधो-
दयरयविरलाहंकारभारेण किंनु॥
iast:
bhavivibhumabhivande saṃbhavaṃ saṃbhavantaṃ
nibiḍajaḍimabhaṅge'bhaṅgaraṅgeṇa geyam.
taraṇihayavareṇābaddhasevaṃ vibodho-
dayarayaviralāhaṃkārabhāreṇa kiṃnu..
hk:
bhavivibhumabhivande saMbhavaM saMbhavantaM
nibiDajaDimabhaGge'bhaGgaraGgeNa geyam.
taraNihayavareNAbaddhasevaM vibodho-
dayarayaviralAhaMkArabhAreNa kiMnu..

deva:
समसमयमिवाऽलं चञ्चलं चित्तमङ्का
हरणहरिवरं वाऽचञ्चलीभावयन्तम्।
उरसि विरसभावं हन्त हन्तुं तुरीयं
तमरिहरमणीयं धारणीयं धरेऽहम्॥
iast:
samasamayamivā'laṃ cañcalaṃ cittamaṅkā
haraṇaharivaraṃ vā'cañcalībhāvayantam.
urasi virasabhāvaṃ hanta hantuṃ turīyaṃ
tamariharamaṇīyaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ dhare'ham..
hk:
samasamayamivA'laM caJcalaM cittamaGkA
haraNaharivaraM vA'caJcalIbhAvayantam.
urasi virasabhAvaM hanta hantuM turIyaM
tamariharamaNIyaM dhAraNIyaM dhare'ham..

deva:
असमसमयपारावारपारीनरीण-
च्छलचरणधुरीणच्छन्नमच्छिन्नमीडे।
महिमभरनिरुद्धामङ्गलं मङ्गलाभू-
विभुमिदमसुबद्धं मङ्गलाकारणं तु॥
iast:
asamasamayapārāvārapārīnarīṇa-
cchalacaraṇadhurīṇacchannamacchinnamīḍe.
mahimabharaniruddhāmaṅgalaṃ maṅgalābhū-
vibhumidamasubaddhaṃ maṅgalākāraṇaṃ tu..
hk:
asamasamayapArAvArapArInarINa-
cchalacaraNadhurINacchannamacchinnamIDe.
mahimabharaniruddhAmaGgalaM maGgalAbhU-
vibhumidamasubaddhaM maGgalAkAraNaM tu..

deva:
तमुदयगिरिचूलाचुम्बि भूच्छायभूरि-
च्छिदुरतरणिबिम्बाभङ्गधामाभिरामम्।
सहभवमिव रागं कुङ्कुमाभं वहन्तं
वह विदुरसुसीमासंभवं देवदेवम्॥
iast:
tamudayagiricūlācumbi bhūcchāyabhūri-
cchidurataraṇibimbābhaṅgadhāmābhirāmam.
sahabhavamiva rāgaṃ kuṅkumābhaṃ vahantaṃ
vaha vidurasusīmāsaṃbhavaṃ devadevam..
hk:
tamudayagiricUlAcumbi bhUcchAyabhUri-
cchidurataraNibimbAbhaGgadhAmAbhirAmam.
sahabhavamiva rAgaM kuGkumAbhaM vahantaM
vaha vidurasusImAsaMbhavaM devadevam..

deva:
अवममवहरन्तु च्छन्दसंचारिपञ्चा-
नणुसमणिफणा मे देवदेवोरुदेहे।
रणभुवि किल भङ्गे मारवीरेण दूरे
सममिह परिहीणा पञ्चबाणी रयेण॥
iast:
avamamavaharantu cchandasaṃcāripañcā-
naṇusamaṇiphaṇā me devadevorudehe.
raṇabhuvi kila bhaṅge māravīreṇa dūre
samamiha parihīṇā pañcabāṇī rayeṇa..
hk:
avamamavaharantu cchandasaMcAripaJcA-
naNusamaNiphaNA me devadevorudehe.
raNabhuvi kila bhaGge mAravIreNa dUre
samamiha parihINA paJcabANI rayeNa..

deva:
सममिह हिमभाजिद्देहदन्तोरुकूलं
धय धवलकरालं सारिभावारिणेदम्।
समलममलयन्तं भूविहायोऽहिगेहं
हिमकरधरमेके देवदेवं नुवामि॥
iast:
samamiha himabhājiddehadantorukūlaṃ
dhaya dhavalakarālaṃ sāribhāvāriṇedam.
samalamamalayantaṃ bhūvihāyo'higehaṃ
himakaradharameke devadevaṃ nuvāmi..
hk:
samamiha himabhAjiddehadantorukUlaM
dhaya dhavalakarAlaM sAribhAvAriNedam.
samalamamalayantaM bhUvihAyo'higehaM
himakaradharameke devadevaM nuvAmi..

deva:
नरवरकुरुरामा नामरामालिचूडा-
मणिभुवमभवन्तं चित्तवासे वसन्तम्
नवमममलभासं भासमिद्धोरुभाल-
च्छलधवलकराभा संकरेणेव विद्धम्॥
iast:
naravarakururāmā nāmarāmālicūḍā-
maṇibhuvamabhavantaṃ cittavāse vasantam
navamamamalabhāsaṃ bhāsamiddhorubhāla-
cchaladhavalakarābhā saṃkareṇeva viddham..
hk:
naravarakururAmA nAmarAmAlicUDA-
maNibhuvamabhavantaM cittavAse vasantam
navamamamalabhAsaM bhAsamiddhorubhAla-
cchaladhavalakarAbhA saMkareNeva viddham..

deva:
निरवमतमनन्दासुन्दरोदारतुन्दि-
स्थलसलिलरुहाली केवली केवलाय।
नवमरसनिलिम्पाहारसाराभिरामं
नवमचरमकुण्डं किंनु भूखण्डमण्डि॥
iast:
niravamatamanandāsundarodāratundi-
sthalasalilaruhālī kevalī kevalāya.
navamarasanilimpāhārasārābhirāmaṃ
navamacaramakuṇḍaṃ kiṃnu bhūkhaṇḍamaṇḍi..
hk:
niravamatamanandAsundarodAratundi-
sthalasalilaruhAlI kevalI kevalAya.
navamarasanilimpAhArasArAbhirAmaM
navamacaramakuNDaM kiMnu bhUkhaNDamaNDi..

deva:
भवभयजयिनन्दाभूपुरोगामिदन्त-
च्छविनिवहभवाभा भूरिभद्राङ्करा मे।
इह किल कलशा(सा?)ली भाववन्दारुदेवा-
सुरनरवरभाले काममुत्तंसकेलिम्॥
iast:
bhavabhayajayinandābhūpurogāmidanta-
cchavinivahabhavābhā bhūribhadrāṅkarā me.
iha kila kalaśā(sā?)lī bhāvavandārudevā-
suranaravarabhāle kāmamuttaṃsakelim..
hk:
bhavabhayajayinandAbhUpurogAmidanta-
cchavinivahabhavAbhA bhUribhadrAGkarA me.
iha kila kalazA(sA?)lI bhAvavandArudevA-
suranaravarabhAle kAmamuttaMsakelim..

deva:
दुरवमपरमोहं हन्तु मोहं जयाभू-
रविनववसुहासी कासरेणावभासी।
सहजजलजलवाहालिङ्गिभागाभिरामो-
दयगिरिगरिमाणं हन्त धत्ते किलाऽयम्॥
iast:
duravamaparamohaṃ hantu mohaṃ jayābhū-
ravinavavasuhāsī kāsareṇāvabhāsī.
sahajajalajalavāhāliṅgibhāgābhirāmo-
dayagirigarimāṇaṃ hanta dhatte kilā'yam..
hk:
duravamaparamohaM hantu mohaM jayAbhU-
ravinavavasuhAsI kAsareNAvabhAsI.
sahajajalajalavAhAliGgibhAgAbhirAmo-
dayagirigarimANaM hanta dhatte kilA'yam..

deva:
स गिरिधरणिभाराधारलीलाधुरीणं
किरिवरममुमङ्के धारयन्तं निरन्तम्।
परमगरिमलाभं लम्भयन्तं किमेवं
विमलममलदेहं चित्तगेहं नयेऽहम्॥
iast:
sa giridharaṇibhārādhāralīlādhurīṇaṃ
kirivaramamumaṅke dhārayantaṃ nirantam.
paramagarimalābhaṃ lambhayantaṃ kimevaṃ
vimalamamaladehaṃ cittagehaṃ naye'ham..
hk:
sa giridharaNibhArAdhAralIlAdhurINaM
kirivaramamumaGke dhArayantaM nirantam.
paramagarimalAbhaM lambhayantaM kimevaM
vimalamamaladehaM cittagehaM naye'ham..

deva:
विभुविमलपुरोगाभङ्गरोगावलीभि-
च्चरणकररुहालीभासमूहा जयन्ति।
नमिपरसुरबाला भालभागे सरागं
किल परमललामाडम्बरं धारयन्ति॥
iast:
vibhuvimalapurogābhaṅgarogāvalībhi-
ccaraṇakararuhālībhāsamūhā jayanti.
namiparasurabālā bhālabhāge sarāgaṃ
kila paramalalāmāḍambaraṃ dhārayanti..
hk:
vibhuvimalapurogAbhaGgarogAvalIbhi-
ccaraNakararuhAlIbhAsamUhA jayanti.
namiparasurabAlA bhAlabhAge sarAgaM
kila paramalalAmADambaraM dhArayanti..

deva:
चरणसरसि सारे किंनु निस्सीमधामा-
मलसलिलसमूहे हेमपङ्केरुहाणि।
पविधरविभुवङ्गासङ्गिभाचपिङ्गरङ्गा
कररुहवरमाला वो विरुद्धं रुणद्धु॥
iast:
caraṇasarasi sāre kiṃnu nissīmadhāmā-
malasalilasamūhe hemapaṅkeruhāṇi.
pavidharavibhuvaṅgāsaṅgibhācapiṅgaraṅgā
kararuhavaramālā vo viruddhaṃ ruṇaddhu..
hk:
caraNasarasi sAre kiMnu nissImadhAmA-
malasalilasamUhe hemapaGkeruhANi.
pavidharavibhuvaGgAsaGgibhAcapiGgaraGgA
kararuhavaramAlA vo viruddhaM ruNaddhu..

deva:
दिवि भुवि चिरकालं चन्द्रभिद्राहुकण्ठी-
रवभवभयभूयोरीणरङ्गं कुरङ्गम्।
तरुणकरुणमङ्के लालयन्तं किलाऽमुं
भविवर! भगवन्तं धेहि हे धीर! चित्ते॥
iast:
divi bhuvi cirakālaṃ candrabhidrāhukaṇṭhī-
ravabhavabhayabhūyorīṇaraṅgaṃ kuraṅgam.
taruṇakaruṇamaṅke lālayantaṃ kilā'muṃ
bhavivara! bhagavantaṃ dhehi he dhīra! citte..
hk:
divi bhuvi cirakAlaM candrabhidrAhukaNThI-
ravabhavabhayabhUyorINaraGgaM kuraGgam.
taruNakaruNamaGke lAlayantaM kilA'muM
bhavivara! bhagavantaM dhehi he dhIra! citte..

deva:
नर! नम परपङ्कावासहिंसाधुरीणा-
खिलभविभयभीरुं दूरभीपङ्कमङ्कम्।
छगवरमवगाढं पालयन्तं सुगूढं
सदयमनयमन्थं कुन्थुदेवं सुसेवम्॥
iast:
nara! nama parapaṅkāvāsahiṃsādhurīṇā-
khilabhavibhayabhīruṃ dūrabhīpaṅkamaṅkam.
chagavaramavagāḍhaṃ pālayantaṃ sugūḍhaṃ
sadayamanayamanthaṃ kunthudevaṃ susevam..
hk:
nara! nama parapaGkAvAsahiMsAdhurINA-
khilabhavibhayabhIruM dUrabhIpaGkamaGkam.
chagavaramavagADhaM pAlayantaM sugUDhaM
sadayamanayamanthaM kunthudevaM susevam..

deva:
तमरममरदत्तामन्दमन्दारमाला-
परिमलरसबद्धालम्बिरोलम्बमालम्।
निरवमनवहेमच्छायकायं नमामो-
मरगिरिमिव कण्ठे वारिवाहावगाढम्॥
iast:
tamaramamaradattāmandamandāramālā-
parimalarasabaddhālambirolambamālam.
niravamanavahemacchāyakāyaṃ namāmo-
maragirimiva kaṇṭhe vārivāhāvagāḍham..
hk:
tamaramamaradattAmandamandAramAlA-
parimalarasabaddhAlambirolambamAlam.
niravamanavahemacchAyakAyaM namAmo-
maragirimiva kaNThe vArivAhAvagADham..

deva:
बहुलमिह वहन्तं कुन्दमन्दारमल्ली-
कुसुममसमवल्लीमञ्जुलं मल्लिदेवम्।
चिरमुरसि वहामो भूरिताराऽविरामा-
वलिविमलविहायोमण्डलं किंनु नीलम्॥
iast:
bahulamiha vahantaṃ kundamandāramallī-
kusumamasamavallīmañjulaṃ mallidevam.
ciramurasi vahāmo bhūritārā'virāmā-
valivimalavihāyomaṇḍalaṃ kiṃnu nīlam..
hk:
bahulamiha vahantaM kundamandAramallI-
kusumamasamavallImaJjulaM mallidevam.
ciramurasi vahAmo bhUritArA'virAmA-
valivimalavihAyomaNDalaM kiMnu nIlam..

deva:
कुवलवलयकायं कुन्दजिद्दन्तपाली-
च्छविभरपरिभोगं देवमल्लीपुरोगम्।
तमरिहमिव सेवे वारिवाहं सवारिं
किमसमबिसकण्ठीमण्डलीलीढकण्ठम्॥
iast:
kuvalavalayakāyaṃ kundajiddantapālī-
cchavibharaparibhogaṃ devamallīpurogam.
tamarihamiva seve vārivāhaṃ savāriṃ
kimasamabisakaṇṭhīmaṇḍalīlīḍhakaṇṭham..
hk:
kuvalavalayakAyaM kundajiddantapAlI-
cchavibharaparibhogaM devamallIpurogam.
tamarihamiva seve vArivAhaM savAriM
kimasamabisakaNThImaNDalIlIDhakaNTham..

deva:
जयभुवि विजयन्ते भासुरा भूरिभासा
दमिवर! नमिदेहे केलिगेहे कलासु।
किमहिमकिरणाभा भाववन्तं नयन्ति
सुदिवसमविरामं चण्डभावं विहाय॥
iast:
jayabhuvi vijayante bhāsurā bhūribhāsā
damivara! namidehe keligehe kalāsu.
kimahimakiraṇābhā bhāvavantaṃ nayanti
sudivasamavirāmaṃ caṇḍabhāvaṃ vihāya..
hk:
jayabhuvi vijayante bhAsurA bhUribhAsA
damivara! namidehe keligehe kalAsu.
kimahimakiraNAbhA bhAvavantaM nayanti
sudivasamavirAmaM caNDabhAvaM vihAya..

deva:
हरिमुरुधरमाणं कम्बुसम्बन्धबन्धु
किमु इह बहुमन्ता कम्बुधारी चिरेण।
नवनवभवकारावासवारी वरीयो-
गवलविमलधामा नेमिनामा ममायम्॥
iast:
harimurudharamāṇaṃ kambusambandhabandhu
kimu iha bahumantā kambudhārī cireṇa.
navanavabhavakārāvāsavārī varīyo-
gavalavimaladhāmā nemināmā mamāyam..
hk:
harimurudharamANaM kambusambandhabandhu
kimu iha bahumantA kambudhArI cireNa.
navanavabhavakArAvAsavArI varIyo-
gavalavimaladhAmA neminAmA mamAyam..

deva:
फणिगुरुफणमालामलम्बिचूडामहीयो-
मणिगणकिरणालसङ्गरङ्गावगाढम्।
अरिहमुरुमहेलासिद्धिसम्पन्नरागा-
रुणमिव गुणगेयं चित्तधेयं धरेयम्॥
iast:
phaṇiguruphaṇamālāmalambicūḍāmahīyo-
maṇigaṇakiraṇālasaṅgaraṅgāvagāḍham.
arihamurumahelāsiddhisampannarāgā-
ruṇamiva guṇageyaṃ cittadheyaṃ dhareyam..
hk:
phaNiguruphaNamAlAmalambicUDAmahIyo-
maNigaNakiraNAlasaGgaraGgAvagADham.
arihamurumahelAsiddhisampannarAgA-
ruNamiva guNageyaM cittadheyaM dhareyam..

deva:
गिरिभुवि हरिभावे बाहुलीलाविभिन्ना-
विरलनिबिडपीडासङ्गमे गाढखिन्नम्।
परिभवपरिहारायेव वोढारमङ्के
हरिवरमरिहन्तं हे नरा! धत्त चित्ते॥
iast:
giribhuvi haribhāve bāhulīlāvibhinnā-
viralanibiḍapīḍāsaṅgame gāḍhakhinnam.
paribhavaparihārāyeva voḍhāramaṅke
harivaramarihantaṃ he narā! dhatta citte..
hk:
giribhuvi haribhAve bAhulIlAvibhinnA-
viralanibiDapIDAsaGgame gADhakhinnam.
paribhavaparihArAyeva voDhAramaGke
harivaramarihantaM he narA! dhatta citte..

deva:
इत्थं स्तोत्रपथं कथञ्चन जिना नीता विनीतात्मना
वृत्तैः प्राकृतसंस्कृतैः समुदितैस्तैः शौरसेन्या समैः।
दद्युः श्रीगुरुसोमसुन्दरमुदास्वादं प्रसादं जवाद्
येनाऽसौ रसिकेव केवलकला लीलायते मय्यपि॥
iast:
itthaṃ stotrapathaṃ kathañcana jinā nītā vinītātmanā
vṛttaiḥ prākṛtasaṃskṛtaiḥ samuditaistaiḥ śaurasenyā samaiḥ.
dadyuḥ śrīgurusomasundaramudāsvādaṃ prasādaṃ javād
yenā'sau rasikeva kevalakalā līlāyate mayyapi..
hk:
itthaM stotrapathaM kathaJcana jinA nItA vinItAtmanA
vRttaiH prAkRtasaMskRtaiH samuditaistaiH zaurasenyA samaiH.
dadyuH zrIgurusomasundaramudAsvAdaM prasAdaM javAd
yenA'sau rasikeva kevalakalA lIlAyate mayyapi..

deva:
श्रीश्रीपुराभिधपुरप्रथितावतारं प्रोल्लासिमुक्तिकमलाहृदि तारहारम्।
श्रीपार्श्वनाथ! जिनराज! मुदा भवन्तं स्तोष्ये प्रभावभवनं जगतीमवन्तम्॥१
iast:
śrīśrīpurābhidhapuraprathitāvatāraṃ prollāsimuktikamalāhṛdi tārahāram.
śrīpārśvanātha! jinarāja! mudā bhavantaṃ stoṣye prabhāvabhavanaṃ jagatīmavantam..1
hk:
zrIzrIpurAbhidhapuraprathitAvatAraM prollAsimuktikamalAhRdi tArahAram.
zrIpArzvanAtha! jinarAja! mudA bhavantaM stoSye prabhAvabhavanaM jagatImavantam..1

deva:
स्वामिन्! निर्मलवाकुलाकणगणैर्निमाप्य सम्पूजिता राज्ञा श्रीखरदूषणेन भवतः श्रीपार्श्व! मूर्तिः पुरा।
श्रीपालेन नराधिपेन तदनु श्रीश्रीपुरेऽस्थापि या सा देव! प्रतिमा तवेयमनघा दिष्ट्याऽद्य दृष्टा मया॥२
iast:
svāmin! nirmalavākulākaṇagaṇairnimāpya sampūjitā rājñā śrīkharadūṣaṇena bhavataḥ śrīpārśva! mūrtiḥ purā.
śrīpālena narādhipena tadanu śrīśrīpure'sthāpi yā sā deva! pratimā taveyamanaghā diṣṭyā'dya dṛṣṭā mayā..2
hk:
svAmin! nirmalavAkulAkaNagaNairnimApya sampUjitA rAjJA zrIkharadUSaNena bhavataH zrIpArzva! mUrtiH purA.
zrIpAlena narAdhipena tadanu zrIzrIpure'sthApi yA sA deva! pratimA taveyamanaghA diSTyA'dya dRSTA mayA..2

deva:
स्वामिन्! नम्रामरनरपते! स्नात्रमात्राम्भसा तेऽद्याऽपि प्रोच्चैः पुर इह दृशो दीप्यते दीप्रदीपः।
तस्य स्पर्शादपि च सकलप्राणभाजां समग्रा रोगा यान्ति क्षतिमथ भवेद् भाग्यसौभाग्यलक्ष्मीः॥३
iast:
svāmin! namrāmaranarapate! snātramātrāmbhasā te'dyā'pi proccaiḥ pura iha dṛśo dīpyate dīpradīpaḥ.
tasya sparśādapi ca sakalaprāṇabhājāṃ samagrā rogā yānti kṣatimatha bhaved bhāgyasaubhāgyalakṣmīḥ..3
hk:
svAmin! namrAmaranarapate! snAtramAtrAmbhasA te'dyA'pi proccaiH pura iha dRzo dIpyate dIpradIpaH.
tasya sparzAdapi ca sakalaprANabhAjAM samagrA rogA yAnti kSatimatha bhaved bhAgyasaubhAgyalakSmIH..3

deva:
नश्यत्सर्वातिशयविभवे म्लेच्छमालावकीर्णे पूर्णे पापैः प्रवहति कलावत्र काले कराले।
आकाशस्थां तव जिनपते! मूर्तिमालोक्य के के नोच्चैर्भूयुर्भविकनिकरा विस्मयस्मेरनेत्राः॥४
iast:
naśyatsarvātiśayavibhave mlecchamālāvakīrṇe pūrṇe pāpaiḥ pravahati kalāvatra kāle karāle.
ākāśasthāṃ tava jinapate! mūrtimālokya ke ke noccairbhūyurbhavikanikarā vismayasmeranetrāḥ..4
hk:
nazyatsarvAtizayavibhave mlecchamAlAvakIrNe pUrNe pApaiH pravahati kalAvatra kAle karAle.
AkAzasthAM tava jinapate! mUrtimAlokya ke ke noccairbhUyurbhavikanikarA vismayasmeranetrAH..4

deva:
श्रीमद्वामेय! देव! त्रिभुवनजनताचिन्तितार्थप्रदाने चिन्तारत्नोपमान! प्रविलसदमलज्ञानसम्पन्निधान!।
रागाद्यान् वैरिवर्गान् हृदि कृतवसतीन् दुःखदौर्गत्यदातॄन् स्वामिन्नन्तं नय त्वं मम चरणधनं लुम्पमानानमानम्॥५
iast:
śrīmadvāmeya! deva! tribhuvanajanatācintitārthapradāne cintāratnopamāna! pravilasadamalajñānasampannidhāna!.
rāgādyān vairivargān hṛdi kṛtavasatīn duḥkhadaurgatyadātṝn svāminnantaṃ naya tvaṃ mama caraṇadhanaṃ lumpamānānamānam..5
hk:
zrImadvAmeya! deva! tribhuvanajanatAcintitArthapradAne cintAratnopamAna! pravilasadamalajJAnasampannidhAna!.
rAgAdyAn vairivargAn hRdi kRtavasatIn duHkhadaurgatyadAtRRn svAminnantaM naya tvaM mama caraNadhanaM lumpamAnAnamAnam..5

deva:
आधिव्याधिज्वरभरमहादुष्टकुष्टप्रमुख्यान् रागान् बाह्यानरतिमदनाज्ञानमिथ्यात्वमोहान्।
अन्तःशत्रूनपि च निखिलांस्त्वां हरन्तं हि दृष्ट्वा मन्ये धन्वन्तरिरयमगात् क्वाऽपि लज्जां दधानः॥६
iast:
ādhivyādhijvarabharamahāduṣṭakuṣṭapramukhyān rāgān bāhyānaratimadanājñānamithyātvamohān.
antaḥśatrūnapi ca nikhilāṃstvāṃ harantaṃ hi dṛṣṭvā manye dhanvantarirayamagāt kvā'pi lajjāṃ dadhānaḥ..6
hk:
AdhivyAdhijvarabharamahAduSTakuSTapramukhyAn rAgAn bAhyAnaratimadanAjJAnamithyAtvamohAn.
antaHzatrUnapi ca nikhilAMstvAM harantaM hi dRSTvA manye dhanvantarirayamagAt kvA'pi lajjAM dadhAnaH..6

deva:
भ्रामं भ्रामं समयममितं पूर्वदुष्कर्मयोगाल्लाभं लाभं कुमतिवशतो दुःखलक्षाणि साक्षात्।
आप्तः प्राप्तस्त्वमिह मयकाऽचिन्तितार्थप्रदाता शश्वद्विश्वत्रितयजनतात्राणकर्तर्जिनेन्द्र!॥७
iast:
bhrāmaṃ bhrāmaṃ samayamamitaṃ pūrvaduṣkarmayogāllābhaṃ lābhaṃ kumativaśato duḥkhalakṣāṇi sākṣāt.
āptaḥ prāptastvamiha mayakā'cintitārthapradātā śaśvadviśvatritayajanatātrāṇakartarjinendra!..7
hk:
bhrAmaM bhrAmaM samayamamitaM pUrvaduSkarmayogAllAbhaM lAbhaM kumativazato duHkhalakSANi sAkSAt.
AptaH prAptastvamiha mayakA'cintitArthapradAtA zazvadvizvatritayajanatAtrANakartarjinendra!..7

deva:
रागद्वेषकषायभीषणमहानक्रौघचक्र-ग्रहग्राहग्रस्तसमग्रविग्रहभृतां दीनारवैर्व्याकुलम्।
संसाराम्बुनिधौ पतन्तमतुलैर्दुष्कर्मभिर्माऽधुना रक्ष त्वं जगतीजनव्रजपरित्राणप्रभूष्णुः प्रभो!॥८
iast:
rāgadveṣakaṣāyabhīṣaṇamahānakraughacakra-grahagrāhagrastasamagravigrahabhṛtāṃ dīnāravairvyākulam.
saṃsārāmbunidhau patantamatulairduṣkarmabhirmā'dhunā rakṣa tvaṃ jagatījanavrajaparitrāṇaprabhūṣṇuḥ prabho!..8
hk:
rAgadveSakaSAyabhISaNamahAnakraughacakra-grahagrAhagrastasamagravigrahabhRtAM dInAravairvyAkulam.
saMsArAmbunidhau patantamatulairduSkarmabhirmA'dhunA rakSa tvaM jagatIjanavrajaparitrANaprabhUSNuH prabho!..8

deva:
प्रस्फूर्जत्फणमण्डलीचलमणिश्रेणीसमाविर्भवच्-चञ्चच्चन्द्रमरीचिसञ्चयपरित्रस्यत्तमोमण्डलः।
उन्मीलन्नवनीलनीरजदलश्यामाभिरामद्युतिः श्रेयःश्रेणिमनुत्तरां प्रथय नः श्रीपार्श्व! विश्वप्रभो!॥९
iast:
prasphūrjatphaṇamaṇḍalīcalamaṇiśreṇīsamāvirbhavac-cañcaccandramarīcisañcayaparitrasyattamomaṇḍalaḥ.
unmīlannavanīlanīrajadalaśyāmābhirāmadyutiḥ śreyaḥśreṇimanuttarāṃ prathaya naḥ śrīpārśva! viśvaprabho!..9
hk:
prasphUrjatphaNamaNDalIcalamaNizreNIsamAvirbhavac-caJcaccandramarIcisaJcayaparitrasyattamomaNDalaH.
unmIlannavanIlanIrajadalazyAmAbhirAmadyutiH zreyaHzreNimanuttarAM prathaya naH zrIpArzva! vizvaprabho!..9

deva:
लब्धः कामघटः स्फुटं सुरगवी गेहाङ्गणेऽद्यागता चिन्तारत्नमथोऽचिरात् करतले प्राप्तं चिरत्नैः शुभैः।
प्राज्यं राज्यमुपार्जितं त्रिजगतां निःशेषसौख्यावहं यत्तेऽजायत दर्शनं जिनपते! काले करालेऽप्यहो॥१०
iast:
labdhaḥ kāmaghaṭaḥ sphuṭaṃ suragavī gehāṅgaṇe'dyāgatā cintāratnamatho'cirāt karatale prāptaṃ ciratnaiḥ śubhaiḥ.
prājyaṃ rājyamupārjitaṃ trijagatāṃ niḥśeṣasaukhyāvahaṃ yatte'jāyata darśanaṃ jinapate! kāle karāle'pyaho..10
hk:
labdhaH kAmaghaTaH sphuTaM suragavI gehAGgaNe'dyAgatA cintAratnamatho'cirAt karatale prAptaM ciratnaiH zubhaiH.
prAjyaM rAjyamupArjitaM trijagatAM niHzeSasaukhyAvahaM yatte'jAyata darzanaM jinapate! kAle karAle'pyaho..10

deva:
मनोवचःकायविजम्भणैर्भृशं शुभेतरैः पापमुपार्जि यन्मया।
तन्मे त्वदीयाननपद्मवीक्षणात् क्षयं क्षणाद् गच्छतु नाथ! सम्प्रति॥११
iast:
manovacaḥkāyavijambhaṇairbhṛśaṃ śubhetaraiḥ pāpamupārji yanmayā.
tanme tvadīyānanapadmavīkṣaṇāt kṣayaṃ kṣaṇād gacchatu nātha! samprati..11
hk:
manovacaHkAyavijambhaNairbhRzaM zubhetaraiH pApamupArji yanmayA.
tanme tvadIyAnanapadmavIkSaNAt kSayaM kSaNAd gacchatu nAtha! samprati..11

deva:
अपारसंसारमहाम्बुराशौ दुरुत्तरे बंभ्रमता मयाऽद्य।
श्रीपार्श्व! विश्वत्रयबान्धवस्त्वं लेभे लसत्पोतसमः स्वपुण्यैः॥१२
iast:
apārasaṃsāramahāmburāśau duruttare baṃbhramatā mayā'dya.
śrīpārśva! viśvatrayabāndhavastvaṃ lebhe lasatpotasamaḥ svapuṇyaiḥ..12
hk:
apArasaMsAramahAmburAzau duruttare baMbhramatA mayA'dya.
zrIpArzva! vizvatrayabAndhavastvaM lebhe lasatpotasamaH svapuNyaiH..12

deva:
पचेलिमैः प्राचिकपुण्यपूरैः समुज्जजृम्भे सकलैर्ममाऽद्य।
यज्जन्मजातैरपि नैव दृष्टो जिनाधुना दृग्विषयीबभूव॥१३॥
iast:
pacelimaiḥ prācikapuṇyapūraiḥ samujjajṛmbhe sakalairmamā'dya.
yajjanmajātairapi naiva dṛṣṭo jinādhunā dṛgviṣayībabhūva..13..
hk:
pacelimaiH prAcikapuNyapUraiH samujjajRmbhe sakalairmamA'dya.
yajjanmajAtairapi naiva dRSTo jinAdhunA dRgviSayIbabhUva..13..

deva:
नेत्रे पवित्रे विशदा च वाणी करौ कृतार्थौ शुचि मानसं च।
यैर्वीक्षितो नाथ! गुणैः स्तुतश्च सम्पूजितश्चाऽऽरुचि चिन्तितश्च॥१४
iast:
netre pavitre viśadā ca vāṇī karau kṛtārthau śuci mānasaṃ ca.
yairvīkṣito nātha! guṇaiḥ stutaśca sampūjitaścā''ruci cintitaśca..14
hk:
netre pavitre vizadA ca vANI karau kRtArthau zuci mAnasaM ca.
yairvIkSito nAtha! guNaiH stutazca sampUjitazcA''ruci cintitazca..14

deva:
कर्माणि दारुणभवार्णवदुःखदानि क्षीणानि मेऽद्य सुकृतानि तथाऽऽविरासन्।
अद्याऽपि मे जिनपते! शुभभाग्ययोगो जागर्ति यत्तव बभूव पदप्रणामः॥१५
iast:
karmāṇi dāruṇabhavārṇavaduḥkhadāni kṣīṇāni me'dya sukṛtāni tathā''virāsan.
adyā'pi me jinapate! śubhabhāgyayogo jāgarti yattava babhūva padapraṇāmaḥ..15
hk:
karmANi dAruNabhavArNavaduHkhadAni kSINAni me'dya sukRtAni tathA''virAsan.
adyA'pi me jinapate! zubhabhAgyayogo jAgarti yattava babhUva padapraNAmaH..15

deva:
इत्थं श्रीपुरभूमिशालिललनाभाले ललामोपमः श्रीमत्पार्श्व! जिनास्तसर्ववृजिनश्चन्द्रोपमानाननः।
भूयो भक्तिभरावननम्रशिरसा नूतो मया भावतो देहि त्वं निजपादपद्मयुगलोपास्तिं प्रशस्तां मम॥१६
iast:
itthaṃ śrīpurabhūmiśālilalanābhāle lalāmopamaḥ śrīmatpārśva! jināstasarvavṛjinaścandropamānānanaḥ.
bhūyo bhaktibharāvananamraśirasā nūto mayā bhāvato dehi tvaṃ nijapādapadmayugalopāstiṃ praśastāṃ mama..16
hk:
itthaM zrIpurabhUmizAlilalanAbhAle lalAmopamaH zrImatpArzva! jinAstasarvavRjinazcandropamAnAnanaH.
bhUyo bhaktibharAvananamrazirasA nUto mayA bhAvato dehi tvaM nijapAdapadmayugalopAstiM prazastAM mama..16

deva:
अङ्गुलिदलाभिरामं सुरनरनिवहालिकुलसमालीढम्।
देव! तव चरणकमलं नमामि संसारभयहरणम्॥
iast:
aṅgulidalābhirāmaṃ suranaranivahālikulasamālīḍham.
deva! tava caraṇakamalaṃ namāmi saṃsārabhayaharaṇam..
hk:
aGgulidalAbhirAmaM suranaranivahAlikulasamAlIDham.
deva! tava caraNakamalaM namAmi saMsArabhayaharaNam..

deva:
कामकरिकुम्भदारण! भवदवजलवाह! विमलगुणनिलय!
किंकिल्लिपल्लवारुण-करचरण! निरुद्धचलकरण!॥
iast:
kāmakarikumbhadāraṇa! bhavadavajalavāha! vimalaguṇanilaya!
kiṃkillipallavāruṇa-karacaraṇa! niruddhacalakaraṇa!..
hk:
kAmakarikumbhadAraNa! bhavadavajalavAha! vimalaguNanilaya!
kiMkillipallavAruNa-karacaraNa! niruddhacalakaraNa!..

deva:
मायारेणुसमीरण! भवभूरुहसिन्धुर! निरीह!
मरणजरामयवारण! मोहमहामल्लबलहरण!॥
iast:
māyāreṇusamīraṇa! bhavabhūruhasindhura! nirīha!
maraṇajarāmayavāraṇa! mohamahāmallabalaharaṇa!..
hk:
mAyAreNusamIraNa! bhavabhUruhasindhura! nirIha!
maraNajarAmayavAraNa! mohamahAmallabalaharaNa!..

deva:
भावारिहरिणहरिवर! संसारमहाजलालयतरण्ड!
कलिलभरतिमिरभासुररविमण्डल! गुणमणिकरण्ड!॥
iast:
bhāvārihariṇaharivara! saṃsāramahājalālayataraṇḍa!
kalilabharatimirabhāsuraravimaṇḍala! guṇamaṇikaraṇḍa!..
hk:
bhAvArihariNaharivara! saMsAramahAjalAlayataraNDa!
kalilabharatimirabhAsuraravimaNDala! guNamaNikaraNDa!..

deva:
अमर-पुरन्दर-किन्नर-नरवरसन्दोहभसलवरकमल!
करुणारसकुलमन्दिर! सिद्धिमहापुरवरनिवास!॥
iast:
amara-purandara-kinnara-naravarasandohabhasalavarakamala!
karuṇārasakulamandira! siddhimahāpuravaranivāsa!..
hk:
amara-purandara-kinnara-naravarasandohabhasalavarakamala!
karuNArasakulamandira! siddhimahApuravaranivAsa!..

deva:
स्वसमयकमलसरोवर! सुरगिरिवरसारसुन्दरावयव!
चिन्तामणिफलसङ्गम! रागोरुगगरुडवरचरण!॥
iast:
svasamayakamalasarovara! suragirivarasārasundarāvayava!
cintāmaṇiphalasaṅgama! rāgorugagaruḍavaracaraṇa!..
hk:
svasamayakamalasarovara! suragirivarasArasundarAvayava!
